fields.name: TurningSpace
fields.description: Position of the manoeuvring space (for wheelchairs).

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- ==== FSYO First Passes==== -->
<PublicationDelivery xmlns="http://www.netex.org.uk/netex" xmlns:siri="http://www.siri.org.uk/siri" xmlns:gml="http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" version="1.1" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.netex.org.uk/netex ../../../xsd/NeTEx_publication.xsd">
	<PublicationTimestamp>2017-12-17T09:30:47.0Z</PublicationTimestamp>
	<ParticipantRef>SYS001</ParticipantRef>
	<!-- ======WHAT WAS REQUESTED ========== -->
	<PublicationRefreshInterval>P1M</PublicationRefreshInterval>
	<Description>Example of simple zonal pass fares.</Description>
	<!-- =============== RESULTS =========== -->
	<dataObjects>
		<CompositeFrame version="1" id="ENT:school_carnet:38" dataSourceRef="ENT:fare_data">
			<frames>
				<!--==== FRAME DEFAULTS ==== -->
				<ResourceFrame id="ENT:1" version="1">
					<dataSources>
						<DataSource id="ENT:fare_data" version="1"/>
					</dataSources>
				</ResourceFrame>
				<FareFrame id="ENT:1" version="1">
					<tariffs>
						<Tariff version="1" id="ENT:school_carnet:380">
							<timeIntervals>
								<TimeInterval id="ENT:school_carnet@academic_year" version="1">
								</TimeInterval>
							</timeIntervals>
							<qualityStructureFactors>
								<!-- Total number of activations possible -->
								<QualityStructureFactor id="ENT:school_carnet@380" version="1">
									<Name>380 activations</Name>
									<Factor>activation</Factor>
									<Value>380</Value>
								</QualityStructureFactor>
								<FareDemandFactor id="ENT:school_carnet@school_day@morning" version="1">
									<validityConditions>
										<AvailabilityCondition id="ENT:school_carnet@school_day@morning" version="1">
											<dayTypes>
												<DayTypeRef ref="ENT:school_day"/>
											</dayTypes>
											<timebands>
												<Timeband id="ENT:school_carnet@morning" version="1">
													<StartTime>07:00:00</StartTime>
													<EndTime>09:00:00</EndTime>
												</Timeband>
											</timebands>
										</AvailabilityCondition>
									</validityConditions>
								</FareDemandFactor>
								<FareDemandFactor id="ENT:school_carnet@school_day@afternoon" version="1">
									<validityConditions>
										<AvailabilityCondition id="ENT:school_carnet@school_day@afternoon" version="1">
											<dayTypes>
												<DayTypeRef ref="ENT:school_day"/>
											</dayTypes>
											<timebands>
												<Timeband id="ENT:school_carnet@afternoon" version="1">
													<StartTime>12:00:00</StartTime>
													<EndTime>16:00:00</EndTime>
												</Timeband>
											</timebands>
										</AvailabilityCondition>
									</validityConditions>
								</FareDemandFactor>
							</qualityStructureFactors>
							<fareStructureElements>
								<FareStructureElement version="1" id="ENT:school_carnet@access_zones">
									<Name>Available zones</Name>
									<TypeOfFareStructureElementRef versionRef="fxc:v1.0" ref="fxc:access"/>
									<GenericParameterAssignment id="ENT:school_carnet@access_zones" version="1" order="1">
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef versionRef="fxc:v1.0" ref="fxc:can_access"/>
										<ValidityParameterGroupingType>XOR</ValidityParameterGroupingType>
										<validityParameters>
											<FareZoneRef versionRef="1" ref="ENT:Bergen@X"/>
											<!--   etc -->

<!-- ==== Complex Fare Example ====== 
This example shows the encoding of complex  TFL fares in  NeTex XML  
It attempts to code as much as possibel of the TfL fare price structure. 


Based on publiushed web pages. at http://www.tfl.gov.uk/tickets

v1.1 Revised & corrected to use Tariff and simpler ids 

===================================================

Issues - How to do Peak times

 Peak/Off peak  times  that  start at a particular  stations .  #Added

Euston + 1 zones


How to state that Travelcard only does metro of zone 3-

Max travel times

18 16 usage paramter price "at child rate" :  Use wIndiritec ref
 
How to do bidirectional fare sections? 

Need to be able to say product does or does not apply to tariff eg Freedom pass travel card on River cruises.
 

Product Family 
need to be able to inherit product eg Oyster basic oyster, oyster phot not transferable ,  Rail cards,  freedom passes.
  


should there be validable element for all tupes - "showcard"
  
1. OVERVIEW
============

   The Fare structure  has a complex zonal matrix  for Metro DLr & Overground (Subrurban rail)
	Bus is flat fare
   Ferry is point to point not subject to capping


   There are single  day, weekly, monthly and annual products.
   There is a pay as you go card (Oyster) that caps to that day car rate.
   Ther are various discount coards (Rail etc) and a Group Ticket.
 
There are several  types of product
       Cash single ride   .  Metro rail has peak/off peak price zonal
					Bus is flat fare

	   Oyster   Pay as you, capped to day price


	    Travel card : daly 

        Various discount cards
 
The TARIFFs is  are defined in terms of   number of units  between  zones.
 
There are separate FARE PRICEs for a one, zone two zone and three zone units, 

There are separate FARE PRODUCTS  for cash oyster, the right to use oyster etc.

There are Separate SALES OFFER PACKAGE for each type of Oyster card, Prepaid tickets, etc.


==================================
2. DETAILS

There are 8  main Tariff zones for the network, plus others.

ZONEs
	    A)  mybus:A  Alpha						 
		 
 

 There are Fare STRUCTURE ELEMENTS for each combination of fare zones & Maximum travel times.
 
A COMPOSITE FRAME is used to group the component FRAMEs

							<Description>
							http://www.tfl.gov.uk/tickets/14308.aspx
Applications for 16+ Oyster photocards will not be accepted at Post Offices between Monday 1 July 2013 and Sunday 1 September 2013.

If you live in a London borough, online applications for 16+ Oyster photocards with free bus and tram travel will not be accepted for the 2013/14 academic year between Monday 1 July and Tuesday 20 August 2013.

Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need to apply during this time.

If you live outside London, you can still apply online for your 16+ Oyster photocard.

If you're under 18, your parent or guardian must apply on your behalf.

Residents of a London borough
If you live in a London borough, you can apply online or at a Post Office.

Apply online

If you're the parent or guardian applying on behalf of a 16-18 year-old who lives in London, you can apply online.

To apply online you will need:

An active, valid email address
A colour, digital photo of your child
Debit or credit card to pay the £10 administration fee
You will be asked for your child's machine readable passport number. If your child does not have a machine-readable passport and you can't complete all the application steps online you may be prompted to:

Download and print off a verification letter
Get the verification letter signed and approved by your child's education establishment
Take the verification letter to the Post Office along with required documentation and pay the £10 administration fee
Apply online
Applying at a Post Office
You can collect a 16+ Zip Oyster photocard application form from a Post Office in London.

If the applicant is eligible for free travel on buses and trams, their school, college or training provider must confirm they meet the education criteria.

You should then submit the completed application at a Post Office in London.

To apply at a Post Office, you will need:

Proof of your address, which must be one of the following:
- Residential utility bill (dated in the last three months)
- Current council tax bill
- Bank, building society or credit card statement (dated in the last three months)
- Council or housing association rent book or statement
- Driving license (full or provisional)
Proof of applicants age, which must be one of the following: 
- Passport
- ID card from a European Economic Area country 
- Birth certificate 
- Driving license (full or provisional)
- Biometric Residency Permit
Proof of education status - the education part of the application needs to be signed and stamped by your child's school/college
You must provide original documents; we don't accept photocopies.

We will send the 16+ Zip Oyster photocard to the address you provide.

If you provide an email address on your application, we will create a web account for you. We will send you an email with instructions on how to log in and activate your web account. You can then manage your card online, order a replacement for a lost, stolen or damaged Oyster photocard, change the photo on an Oyster photocard or order an Oyster photocard for another child.

							<Description> 
							
Can I get a 16+ Oyster photocard?

If you're 16 or 17
Your parent/guardian can apply for a 16+ Oyster photocard for you, which will allow you to travel at reduced rate on bus, Tube, tram, DLR, London Overground and some National Rail services.

If you were 18 or under on 31 August 2012
You may be eligible for a 16+ Oyster photocard which gives free travel on buses and trams as well as reduced rates on Tube, DLR, London Overground and some National Rail services.

To be eligible for free bus and tram travel, you must:

Be in full-time education
And live in a London borough
Full-time education criteria:

At least 12 hours of guided learning per week, between 09:00-17:00 Monday-Friday, for at least 10 weeks on further education courses at Level 3 or below in a sixth form college, academy, further education college or other training provider  
Examples of Level 3 courses include A levels (AS/A2), vocational awards such as BTEC or City and Guilds qualifications at level 3 and the International Baccalaureate. It can also include apprenticeships and training courses funded by the Education Funding Agency provided the student is 18 or under on 31 August 2012. Your school, college or training provider will be able to confirm if the course qualifies
You're not eligible for free bus and tram travel if:

You don't live in a London borough and/or
You're not in full time education 
If you were under 16 on 31 August 2012
You can apply for an 11-15 Oyster photocard that you can use to travel free on buses and trams and to buy child rate Travelcards. You can continue to use the 11-15 Oyster photocard after you turn 16, until the expiry date printed on the front of the card.

You can also get 34 per cent off the off-peak daily price caps if you get a 16-25 National RailCard and add the discount GIVING ENTITLEMENT your 16+ Oyster photocard
You do not need a 16+ Oyster photocard to pay cash single fares or to buy Day Travelcards

							<Description>You can put Adult, 18+ Student, 16+, child and job_centre Plus Travel Discount 7 Day monthly and longer period Travelcards and Bus and Tram passes on Oyster.

	You can get a Freedom Pass if your only or main home is in a London borough and:

You were 60 or older before 6 April 2010
You turned 60 on or after 6 April 2010 and meet the new age criteria
Or have an eligible disability
Eligible disability
You can also get a Freedom Pass if you:

Are blind or partially sighted
Or are profoundly or severely deaf
Or are without speech
Or have a disability, or have suffered an injury which makes walking more difficult
Or have no arms or have a long-term loss of the use of both arms
Or have a learning disability
Or have been refused a licence on the grounds of your disability


How do I use my Freedom Pass?

Once you've got your pass you can start using it immediately.

touch_ing in and out
Make sure you touch your card on the yellow card readers. It's a bit different for each type of transport. Find out more about touch_ing in and out.

Using your pass outside London
If you've got a rose symbol or a bus hologram on your pass you can use it on local buses all over England. You can use it between 09:30 and 23:00 on weekdays and at any time on weekends and public holidays.

Concessionary bus passes from outside London
If you've got a National Concessionary pass from an English council outside London you can use it at any time on buses in London displaying this symbol.

On buses not showing this sign check with the driver - most will let you travel free between 09:30 and 23:00 on weekdays and at any time on weekends and public holidays.

You'll need to show your pass to the driver.

No one else can use your pass. You can't use it on Tube, tram, DLR, London Overground or National Rail services.

							<Description>Visitor Oyster cards are plastic smartcards you can use instead of paper tickets. Put pay as you go credit on it which you use when you travel. It is the cheapest way to pay for single journeys on bus, Tube, tram, DLR, London Overground and most National Rail services in London.

						<SalesOfferPackage version="any" id="tfl:16PlusZip_OysterPhotoCard-SOP">
							<Name>16 Plus ZIP  Oyster Product is carried on Oyster card</Name>
							<Description>If you're:
Aged 16 to 18
You can get a 16+ Zip Oyster photocard to pay:
Child rate for 7 Day, monthly or longer period Travelcards and Bus and Tram Passes 
Half the adult pay as you go rate on bus, Tube, tram, DLR, London Overground and some National Rail services
If eligible, you can get free travel on buses and trams.
If you're under 18, a parent or guardian must apply on your behalf. You can apply online or at a Post Office in London.		


If you're 16 or 17
Your parent/guardian can apply for a 16+ Oyster photocard for you, which will allow you to travel at reduced rate on bus, Tube, tram, DLR, London Overground and some National Rail services.

If you were 18 or under on 31 August 2012
You may be eligible for a 16+ Oyster photocard which gives free travel on buses and trams as well as reduced rates on Tube, DLR, London Overground and some National Rail services.

To be eligible for free bus and tram travel, you must:

Be in full-time education
And live in a London borough
Full-time education criteria:

At least 12 hours of guided learning per week, between 09:00-17:00 Monday-Friday, for at least 10 weeks on further education courses at Level 3 or below in a sixth form college, academy, further education college or other training provider  
Examples of Level 3 courses include A levels (AS/A2), vocational awards such as BTEC or City and Guilds qualifications at level 3 and the International Baccalaureate. It can also include apprenticeships and training courses funded by the Education Funding Agency provided the student is 18 or under on 31 August 2012. Your school, college or training provider will be able to confirm if the course qualifies
You're not eligible for free bus and tram travel if:

You don't live in a London borough and/or
You're not in full time education 
If you were under 16 on 31 August 2012
You can apply for an 11-15 Oyster photocard that you can use to travel free on buses and trams and to buy child rate Travelcards. You can continue to use the 11-15 Oyster photocard after you turn 16, until the expiry date printed on the front of the card.

Terms and conditions 16+ Oyster photocard
					
			 
			 
Applications for 16+ Oyster photocards will not be accepted at Post Offices between Monday 1 July 2013 and Sunday 1 September 2013.

If you live in a London borough, online applications for 16+ Oyster photocards with free bus and tram travel will not be accepted for the 2013/14 academic year between Monday 1 July and Tuesday 20 August 2013.

Call us on 0343 222 1234 if you need to apply during this time.
If you live outside London, you can still apply online for your 16+ Oyster photocard.
If you're under 18, your parent or guardian must apply on your behalf.

Residents of a London borough
If you live in a London borough, you can apply online or at a Post Office.

Apply online

If you're the parent or guardian applying on behalf of a 16-18 year-old who lives in London, you can apply online.
To apply online you will need:

An active, valid email address
A colour, digital photo of your child
Debit or credit card to pay the £10 administration fee
You will be asked for your child's machine readable passport number. If your child does not have a machine-readable passport and you can't complete all the application steps online you may be prompted to:

Download and print off a verification letter
Get the verification letter signed and approved by your child's education establishment
Take the verification letter to the Post Office along with required documentation and pay the £10 administration fee
Apply online
Applying at a Post Office
You can collect a 16+ Zip Oyster photocard application form from a Post Office in London.

If the applicant is eligible for free travel on buses and trams, their school, college or training provider must confirm they meet the education criteria.

You should then submit the completed application at a Post Office in London.

To apply at a Post Office, you will need:

Proof of your address, which must be one of the following:
- Residential utility bill (dated in the last three months)
- Current council tax bill
- Bank, building society or credit card statement (dated in the last three months)
- Council or housing association rent book or statement
- Driving license (full or provisional)
Proof of applicants age, which must be one of the following: 
- Passport
- ID card from a European Economic Area country 
- Birth certificate 
- Driving license (full or provisional)
- Biometric Residency Permit
Proof of education status - the education part of the application needs to be signed and stamped by your child's school/college
You must provide original documents; we don't accept photocopies.

We will send the 16+ Zip Oyster photocard to the address you provide.

If you provide an email address on your application, we will create a web account for you. We will send you an email with instructions on how to log in and activate your web account. You can then manage your card online, order a replacement for a lost, stolen or damaged Oyster photocard, change the photo on an Oyster photocard or order an Oyster photocard for another child.

UK applicants outside London
If you're the parent or guardian applying on behalf of a 16 or 17 year-old who lives outside London, you need to apply online.

To apply online, you will  need:

An active, valid email address
Your child's machine-readable passport number
A digital photo of your child
Credit or debit card to pay the £10 administration fee
If we're able to verify your child's age online:

We will post the 16+ Zip Oyster photocard to the address you provide. It can take up to two weeks for the photocard to be delivered.

If we're unable to verify your child's age online:

You'll have to collect the photocard from a London Travel Information Centre. You can select a Travel Information Centre to collect from during the application process. It can take up to four weeks for your application to be processed.

Apply online
Non UK applicants
If you're the parent or guardian of a 16 or 17 year-old who lives outside the UK, you need to apply online.

We can't post Oyster photocards outside of the UK, so you need to select a Travel Information Centre to collect the photocard from during the application process. 

You must apply at least four weeks in advance of collecting the Oyster photocard. You can apply up to three months before the collection date.

To apply you will need:

An active, valid email address
A digital photo of your child
Credit or debit card to pay the £10 administration fee
You need to bring your confirmation email and proof of the applicants' age when collecting the Oyster photocard from a London Travel Information Centre. This can be either:

Passport
ID card from a European Economic Area country 
Birth certificate 
Driving license (full or provisional)
You must provide original documents - we don't accept photocopies.

							<Description>If you are:

Enrolled in an eligible full-time or part-time course
Living at a London address during term time

Save 30 per cent against the price of adult rate Travelcards and Bus and Tram Passes.

Confirm your details and accept the 2012/2013 Terms and Conditions

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- ==== Simple Point to Point Fare  Example ====== 
This example shows the encoding of a simple point to point  fare set for a simple bus timetable for a   route in NeTex XML  
 
Uses Point To Point fares. There is a single FARE PRODUCT  and a single SALES OFFER PACKAGE

It is based  on the same route used in other bus  examples  e.g. 
		Bus_SimpleTimetable_WithTimings example to see LINKS & PATTERNs
 
 
(C) CEN & Crown Copyright 2018, 2019 
Free to use under a Creative Commons license.

v1.1 Revised & corrected to use Tariff and simpler ids

===================================================

1. OVERVIEW
============

   This has just  three stops         A - B  - C   
 
Point to point  Fare matrix

From To	  Price    
						A	    B 				C
    A   		 -		1.00 EUR	 	3.00 EUR		 
    B		 	-			-				2.00 EUR	
	C			 -			-					-
	
They are all on a single LINE 1
==================================
2. DETAILS

The network is for  OPERATOR    mybus:DTA

There is a LINE  mybus:Line_1

SCHEDULED STOP POINTs
	    A)   mybus:ssp_001  Alpha						 
		B)   mybus:ssp_002   Bravo							 
		C)   mybus:ssp_077	 Charley

TARIFF   There is a single tariff:   myfares:PointToPoint

The fare structure has two elements

   (i) FARESTRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:PointToPoint@access
 
      There are DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENTs for each origin /destination
		AB  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:SSP_001+SSP_002 
		AC  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:SSP_001+SSP_077 
		BC  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:SSP_002+SSP_077 
     
   (ii) FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:PointToPoint@conditions_of_use
		ROUND TRIP :  myfares:PointToPoint@conditions_of_travel@trip  Single
		FREQUENCY OF USE   myfares:PointToPoint@conditions_of_travel@frequency"> single use 
        INTERCHANGING 	 myfares:PointToPoint@conditions_of_travel@interchanging  not allowed
 
There is a SINGLE FARE PRODUCT myfares:Single_trip
      It has a VALIDABLE ELEMENT    myfares:Single_trip@travel  that references  the two FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs

There is a SINGLE SALES OFFER PACKAGE   myfares:Single_trip-SOP 
      It has a SALES OFFER PACKAGE ELEMENT     myfares:Single_trip-SOP@p-ticket  that references   SINGLE FARE PRODUCT myfares:Single_trip
       it uses TYPE OF TRAVEK DOCUMENT paper myfares:paper_ticket"
 
  There is a PRICE GROUP  myfares:Line_1 with a price for each DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT
		AB  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:SSP_001+SSP_002
				FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT PRICE:  myfares:SSP_001+SSP_002   1.00 EUR

		AC  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:SSP_001+SSP_077
				FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT PRICE:  myfares:SSP_001+SSP_077   3.00 EUR

		BC  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:SSP_002+SSP_077
				FARE STRUCTUR ELEMENT PRICE:  myfares:SSP_002+SSP_077   2.00 EUR
     
A COMPOSITE FRAME is used to group the component FRAMEs
 
   - It has a VALIDITY CONDITION  that specifies it is valid between hiven dates
		A SERVICE  FRAME is used to contain the STOP POINT  elements   LINE, etc
		A FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE   product  elements 
		A separate  FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE   price  elements 
		 A RESOURCE FRAME is used to contain  common code values 
-->
<PublicationDelivery xmlns="http://www.netex.org.uk/netex" xmlns:siri="http://www.siri.org.uk/siri" xmlns:gml="http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" version="1.0" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.netex.org.uk/netex ../../../xsd/NeTEx_publication.xsd">
	<PublicationTimestamp>2010-12-17T09:30:47.0Z</PublicationTimestamp>
	<ParticipantRef>SYS001</ParticipantRef>
	<!--- ======WHAT WAS REQUESTED ========== -->
	<PublicationRequest version="1.0">
		<RequestTimestamp>2010-12-17T09:30:47.0Z</RequestTimestamp>
		<ParticipantRef>SYS002</ParticipantRef>
		<topics>
			<NetworkFrameTopic>
				<selectionValidityConditions>
					<AvailabilityCondition version="any" id="range">
						<FromDate>2011-01-01T00:00:00Z</FromDate>
					</AvailabilityCondition>
				</selectionValidityConditions>
				<FareFrameRef ref="myfares:any">REQUEST</FareFrameRef>
			</NetworkFrameTopic>
		</topics>
	</PublicationRequest>
	<PublicationRefreshInterval>P1M</PublicationRefreshInterval>
	<Description>Example  of simple point to point fares</Description>
	<!--- =============== RESULTS =========== -->
	<dataObjects>
		<CompositeFrame version="1.0" id="myfares:DTA@Line_1">
			<validityConditions>
				<ValidBetween>
					<FromDate>2011-01-01T00:00:00Z</FromDate>
					<ToDate>2011-07-01T00:00:00Z</ToDate>
				</ValidBetween>
			</validityConditions>
			<!--- ======= CODESPACEs======== -->
			<codespaces>
				<Codespace id="mybus">
					<Xmlns>mybus</Xmlns>
					<XmlnsUrl>http://www.mybuses.eu/stuff</XmlnsUrl>
					<Description>My buses</Description>
				</Codespace>
				<Codespace id="myfares">
					<Xmlns>myfares</Xmlns>
					<XmlnsUrl>http://www.myfares,com/fares</XmlnsUrl>
					<Description>Fare data</Description>
				</Codespace>
			</codespaces>
			<!--- =======FRAME DEFAULTS======== -->
			<FrameDefaults>
				<DefaultCodespaceRef ref="myfares"/>
			</FrameDefaults>
			<frames>
				<ServiceFrame version="1.0" id="mybus:DTA@Line_1@network">
					<Name>Stops for Line 1 Tariff</Name>
					<FrameDefaults>
						<DefaultCodespaceRef ref="mybus"/>
					</FrameDefaults>
					<prerequisites>
						<ResourceFrameRef version="1.0" ref="mybus:DTA@Common_Resources"/>
					</prerequisites>
					<lines>
						<Line version="any" id="mybus:Line_1">
							<Name>Line 1</Name>
							<OperatorRef version="any" ref="mybus:DTA"/>
						</Line>
					</lines>
					<!--- =========STOP POINTs============ -->
					<scheduledStopPoints>
						<ScheduledStopPoint version="any" id="mybus:SSP_001">
							<Name>Alpha & Castle</Name>
							<Location>
								<Longitude>53.0000</Longitude>
								<Latitude>0.1000</Latitude>
							</Location>
							<TimingPointStatus>timingPoint</TimingPointStatus>
							<ShortName>Alpha</ShortName>
							<PublicCode>ALPH</PublicCode>
							<StopType>onstreetBus</StopType>
							<VehicleModes>bus</VehicleModes>
						</ScheduledStopPoint>
						<ScheduledStopPoint version="any" id="mybus:SSP_002">
							<Name>Bravo Street</Name>
							<Location>
								<Longitude>53.2000</Longitude>
								<Latitude>0.2000</Latitude>
							</Location>
							<TimingPointStatus>timingPoint</TimingPointStatus>
							<ShortName>Bravo</ShortName>
							<PublicCode>BRAV</PublicCode>
							<StopType>onstreetBus</StopType>
							<VehicleModes>bus</VehicleModes>
						</ScheduledStopPoint>
						<ScheduledStopPoint version="any" id="mybus:SSP_077">
							<Name>Charley Crescent</Name>
							<Location>
								<Longitude>53.3000</Longitude>
								<Latitude>0.3000</Latitude>
							</Location>
							<TimingPointStatus>timingPoint</TimingPointStatus>
							<ShortName>Charley</ShortName>
							<PublicCode>CHAS</PublicCode>
							<StopType>onstreetBus</StopType>
							<VehicleModes>bus</VehicleModes>
						</ScheduledStopPoint>
					</scheduledStopPoints>
				</ServiceFrame>
				<!--- =============== FAREs =========== -->
				<FareFrame version="1.0" id="myfares:DTA@Line_1@products">
					<Name>Fare Products  for Line 1 </Name>
					<prerequisites>
						<ServiceFrameRef version="1.0" ref="mybus:DTA@Line_1@network"/>
					</prerequisites>
					<!--- ====Fare Structure======= -->
					<tariffs>
						<Tariff version="1.0" id="myfares:PointToPoint">
							<Name>Point to pont tariff</Name>
							<OperatorRef version="any" ref="mybus:DTA"/>
							<TypeOfTariffRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:point_to_point"/>
							<fareStructureElements>
								<FareStructureElement version="1.0" id="myfares:PointToPoint@access">
									<distanceMatrixElements>
										<DistanceMatrixElementRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:SSP_001+SSP_002"/>
										<DistanceMatrixElementRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:SSP_001+SSP_077"/>
										<DistanceMatrixElementRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:SSP_002+SSP_077"/>
									</distanceMatrixElements>
									<GenericParameterAssignment order="1" id="myfares:PointToPoint@access" version="1.0">
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:can_access"/>
										<ValidityParameterGroupingType>XOR</ValidityParameterGroupingType>
										<validityParameters>
											<OperatorRef version="any" ref="mybus:DTA"/>
											<LineRef version="any" ref="mybus:Line_1"/>
										</validityParameters>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
								<FareStructureElement id="myfares:PointToPoint@conditions_of_travel" version="1.0">
									<Name>Conditions of Travel </Name>
									<GenericParameterAssignment version="1.0" order="1" id="myfares:PointToPoint@conditions_of_travel">
										<Name>Conditions of travel</Name>
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:condition_of_use"/>
										<LimitationGroupingType>AND</LimitationGroupingType>
										<limitations>
											<RoundTrip version="1.0" id="myfares:PointToPoint@conditions_of_travel@trip">
												<Name>Single Trip</Name>
												<TripType>single</TripType>
											</RoundTrip>
											<FrequencyOfUse version="1.0" id="myfares:PointToPoint@conditions_of_travel@frequency">
												<Name>One trip no transfers</Name>
												<FrequencyOfUseType>single</FrequencyOfUseType>
												<MaximalFrequency>1</MaximalFrequency>
											</FrequencyOfUse>
											<Interchanging version="1.0" id="myfares:PointToPoint@conditions_of_travel@interchanging">
												<FromMode>bus</FromMode>
												<ToMode>bus</ToMode>
												<MaximumNumberOfInterchanges>0</MaximumNumberOfInterchanges>
												<CanBreakJourney>false</CanBreakJourney>
											</Interchanging>
										</limitations>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
							</fareStructureElements>
							<distanceMatrixElements>
								<DistanceMatrixElement version="1.0" id="myfares:SSP_001+SSP_002">
									<Name>Alpha to Bravo</Name>
									<StartStopPointRef version="any" ref="mybus:SSP_001"/>
									<EndStopPointRef version="any" ref="mybus:SSP_002"/>
									<prices>
										<DistanceMatrixElementPriceRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:SSP_001+SSP_002"/>
									</prices>
								</DistanceMatrixElement>
								<DistanceMatrixElement version="1.0" id="myfares:SSP_001+SSP_077">
									<Name>Alpha to Charley</Name>
									<StartStopPointRef version="any" ref="mybus:SSP_001"/>
									<EndStopPointRef version="any" ref="mybus:SSP_077"/>
									<prices>
										<DistanceMatrixElementPriceRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:SSP_001+SSP_077"/>
									</prices>
								</DistanceMatrixElement>
								<DistanceMatrixElement version="1.0" id="myfares:SSP_002+SSP_077">
									<Name>Bravo to Charley</Name>
									<StartStopPointRef version="any" ref="mybus:SSP_002"/>
									<EndStopPointRef version="any" ref="mybus:SSP_077"/>
									<prices>
										<DistanceMatrixElementPriceRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:SSP_002+SSP_077"/>
									</prices>
								</DistanceMatrixElement>
							</distanceMatrixElements>
							<priceGroups>
								<PriceGroupRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:Line_1"/>
							</priceGroups>
						</Tariff>
					</tariffs>
					<!--- ====Fare Product======= -->
					<fareProducts>
						<PreassignedFareProduct version="1.0" id="myfares:Single_trip">
							<Name>Single trip</Name>
							<TypeOfFareProductRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:trip"/>
							<OperatorRef version="any" ref="mybus:DTA"/>
							<!--- ====VALIDABLE ELEMENTs====== -->
							<validableElements>
								<ValidableElement version="1.0" id="myfares:Single_trip@travel">
									<Name>Single trip</Name>
									<fareStructureElements>
										<FareStructureElementRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:PointToPoint@access"/>
										<FareStructureElementRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:PointToPoint@conditions_of_travel"/>
									</fareStructureElements>
								</ValidableElement>
							</validableElements>
							<!--- ====ACCESS RIGHTs======= -->
							<accessRightsInProduct>
								<AccessRightInProduct version="1.0" id="myfares:Single_trip@travel" order="1">
									<Name>First ride</Name>
									<IsFirstInSequence>true</IsFirstInSequence>
									<IsLastInSequence>true</IsLastInSequence>
									<ValidableElementRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:Single_trip@travel"/>
								</AccessRightInProduct>
							</accessRightsInProduct>
						</PreassignedFareProduct>
					</fareProducts>
					<!--- ====Sales Packages ====== -->
					<salesOfferPackages>
						<SalesOfferPackage version="1.0" id="myfares:Single_trip-SOP@p-ticket">
							<Name>Single, Paper Ticket </Name>
							<salesOfferPackageElements>
								<SalesOfferPackageElement order="1" version="1.0" id="myfares:Single_trip-SOP@p-ticket">
									<TypeOfTravelDocumentRef version="any" ref="myfares:paper_ticket"/>
									<FareProductRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:Single_trip"/>
								</SalesOfferPackageElement>
							</salesOfferPackageElements>
						</SalesOfferPackage>
					</salesOfferPackages>
				</FareFrame>
				<FareFrame version="1.0" id="myfares:DTA@Line_1@prices">
					<Name>Prices for Line 1 </Name>
					<FrameDefaults>
						<DefaultCurrency>EUR</DefaultCurrency>
					</FrameDefaults>
					<prerequisites>
						<FareFrameRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:DTA@Line_1@products"/>
					</prerequisites>
					<priceGroups>
						<PriceGroup version="1.0" id="myfares:Line_1">
							<members>
								<DistanceMatrixElementPrice version="1.0" id="myfares:SSP_001+SSP_002">
									<Amount>1.00</Amount>
									<DistanceMatrixElementRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:SSP_001+SSP_002"/>
								</DistanceMatrixElementPrice>
								<DistanceMatrixElementPrice version="1.0" id="myfares:SSP_001+SSP_077">
									<Amount>3.00</Amount>
									<DistanceMatrixElementRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:SSP_001+SSP_077"/>
								</DistanceMatrixElementPrice>
								<DistanceMatrixElementPrice version="1.0" id="myfares:SSP_002+SSP_077">
									<Amount>2.00</Amount>
									<DistanceMatrixElementRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:SSP_002+SSP_077"/>
								</DistanceMatrixElementPrice>
							</members>
						</PriceGroup>
					</priceGroups>
				</FareFrame>
				<!--   ==== COMMON RESOURCES  ==   -->
				<ResourceFrame version="1.0" id="mybus:DTA@Common_Resources">
					<Name>Common resources</Name>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- ==== Simple Point to Point Fare with  different media offers  Example ====== 
This example shows the encoding of a point to point tariff for a simple bus timetable for a linear route in NeTex XML  
    
There are separate packages for with different prices for paper and mobile tickets

There are separate prices for first and second class  

Data is Fictional 

(C) CEN & Crown Copyright 2018, 2019 
Free to use under a Creative Commons license.

v1.1 Revised & corrected to use Tariff and simpler ids

===================================================
 
1. OVERVIEW
============

 Network  has just one line with  three stops         A - B  - C   
 
Point to point  Fare matrix

From To	Adult Price    
						A	    B 				C
    A   		 -			A_B	      	 A_C
    B		 	-			-			     B_C
	C			 -			-					-

paper ticket
			From To	Adult Price   Child price     1st Class
DME1:   	A  B		1.00 EUR		50%				1.50 EUR	
DME2   	A  C		3.00 EUR		50%				5.00 EUR	
DME3:		B  C		2.00 EUR		50%				3.00 EUR	

mobile app
			From To	Adult Price   Child price     1st Class
DME1:   	A  B		0.90 EUR		50%				1.40 EUR	
DME2   	A  C		2.70 EUR		50%				4.80 EUR	
DME3:		B  C		1.90 EUR		50%				280 EUR	
	
==================================
2. DETAILS

There is one LINE :  mybus:LN_24 on which the fare is valid   this is assigned  to a GROUP OF LINES 

SCHEDULED STOP POINTs
	    A)   mybus:ssp_001  Alpha						 
		B)  mybus:ssp_002   Bravo							 
		C)  mybus:ssp_077	 Charley

TARIFF   There is a single tariff:   myfares:PointToPoint

The fare structure has fiur  elements 

   (i) FARESTRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:PointToPoint@access
 
      There are DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENTs for each origin /destination
		AB  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:SSP_001+SSP_002 
		AC  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:SSP_001+SSP_077 
		BC  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:SSP_002+SSP_077 


   (ii) FARESTRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:PointToPoint@eligibility
 
       There is a GENERIC PARAMETER ASSIGNMENT  with a choice of two parameters
			   USER PROFILE  myfares:adult
			USER PROFILE  myfares:child 

   (iii) FARESTRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:PointToPoint@classes_of_use

 There is a GENERIC PARAMETER ASSIGNMENT  with a choice of two parameters
			  CLASSES OF USE   myfares:standard
			 CLASSES OF USE   myfares:fisrt
  
     
   (iiv FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:PointToPoint@conditions_of_use
		ROUND TRIP :  myfares:PointToPoint@conditions_of_travel@trip  Single
		FREQUENCY OF USE   myfares:PointToPoint@conditions_of_travel@frequency"> single use 
        INTERCHANGING 	 myfares:PointToPoint@conditions_of_travel@interchanging  not allowed
 
There is a SINGLE FARE PRODUCT myfares:Single_trip
      It has a VALIDABLE ELEMENT    myfares:Single_trip@travel  that references  the four FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs

There are  two SALES OFFER PACKAGEs, one for printed tickets, one for mobbiles; they use teh same fare PRODUCTs that use the same TARIFF of FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENts

   SALES OFFER PACKAGEs myfares:Single_trip-SOP@p-ticket
      It has a SALES OFFER PACKAGE ELEMENT     myfares:Single_trip-SOP@p-ticket  that references   SINGLE FARE PRODUCT myfares:Single_trip
       it uses TYPE OF TRAVEL DOCUMENT paper myfares:paper_ticket"
   SALES OFFER PACKAGEs myfares:Single_trip-SOP@m-ticket
      It has a SALES OFFER PACKAGE ELEMENT     myfares:Single_trip-SOP@m-ticket  that references   SINGLE FARE PRODUCT myfares:Single_trip
       it uses TYPE OF TRAVEL DOCUMENT paper myfares:mobile_app
 
  There is a FARE TABLE  myfares:Line_1 containg sub FARETABLEs to  organise fare prices by SALES OFFER PACKAGE /  CLASS OF USE / DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT

     There  a price for each DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT
		AB  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:SSP_001+SSP_002
				FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT PRICE:  myfares:SSP_001+SSP_002   1.00 EUR

		AC  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:SSP_001+SSP_077
				FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT PRICE:  myfares:SSP_001+SSP_077   3.00 EUR

		BC  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:SSP_002+SSP_077
				FARE STRUCTUR ELEMENT PRICE:  myfares:SSP_002+SSP_077   2.00 EUR
     
  
A COMPOSITE FRAME is used to group the component FRAMEs
 
   - It has a VALIDITY CONDITION  that specifies it is valid between hiven dates
		A SERVICE  FRAME is used to contain the STOP POINT  elements   LINE, etc
		A FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE   product  elements 
		A separate  FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE   price  elements 
		 A RESOURCE FRAME is used to contain  common code values 
 
-->
<PublicationDelivery xmlns="http://www.netex.org.uk/netex" xmlns:siri="http://www.siri.org.uk/siri" xmlns:gml="http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" version="1.0" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.netex.org.uk/netex ../../../xsd/NeTEx_publication.xsd">

			</validityConditions>
			<!--- ======= CODESPACEs======== -->
			<codespaces>

				<Codespace id="myfares">

			</codespaces>
			<!--- =======FRAME DEFAULTS======== -->
			<FrameDefaults>
				<DefaultCodespaceRef ref="myfares"/>

			</FrameDefaults>
			<frames>
				<ServiceFrame version="1.0" id="mybus:DTA@Line24@network">

					<prerequisites>
						<ResourceFrameRef version="1.0" ref="mybus:DTA@Common_resources"/>

					<lines>

					</lines>
					<!--- === GROUPs OF LINEs ========= -->
					<groupsOfLines>

							<members>
								<LineRef version="any" ref="mybus:LN_24"/>
							</members>

					</groupsOfLines>
					<!--- =========STOP POINTs============ -->

								<Latitude>0.1000</Latitude>
							</Location>
							<ShortName>Alpha</ShortName>
							<PublicCode>ALPH</PublicCode>
						</ScheduledStopPoint>
						<ScheduledStopPoint version="any" id="mybus:SSP_002">
							<Name>Bravo Street</Name>
							<Location>
								<Longitude>53.2000</Longitude>
								<Latitude>0.2000</Latitude>
							</Location>
							<ShortName>Bravo</ShortName>
							<PublicCode>BRAV</PublicCode>

							<Location>
								<Longitude>53.3000</Longitude>
								<Latitude>0.3000</Latitude>
							</Location>
							<ShortName>Charley</ShortName>
							<PublicCode>CHAS</PublicCode>

					</scheduledStopPoints>
				</ServiceFrame>
				<!--- =============== FAREs =========== -->

					<!--- ====Fare Structure======= -->

										<validityParameters>
											<GroupOfLinesRef version="any" ref="mybus:my_lines"/>
										</validityParameters>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
								<FareStructureElement version="1.0" id="myfares:PointToPoint_01@eligibility">
									<Name>Eligible user types</Name>
									<GenericParameterAssignment order="1" id="myfares:PointToPoint_01@eligibility" version="1.0">
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:eligible"/>
										<LimitationGroupingType>XOR</LimitationGroupingType>
										<limitations>

										</limitations>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
								<FareStructureElement version="1.0" id="myfares:PointToPoint_01@classes_of_use">
									<Name>Available classes of use</Name>
									<GenericParameterAssignment order="1" id="myfares:PointToPoint_01@classes_of_use" version="1.0">

										<validityParameters>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- ==== Simple Zone to Zone Fare  Example ====== 
This example shows the encoding of a Zone to zone tariff for a simple busn etwork in  NeTex XML  

Uses Zone To Zone fares.  There is a discount for children 16 or under
  
Data is Fictional 

(C) CEN & Crown Copyright 2018, 2019 
Free to use under a Creative Commons license.

v1.1 Revised & corrected to use Tariff and simpler ids

===================================================
   
1. OVERVIEW
============
There are five stops
   The first route has just  three stops       	  A - B  - C    
		The second route 	has stops						B	- Q  - R
	
	
	TARIFF ZONE 1 has SCHEDULED STOP POINT : A
	TARIFF ZONE 2 has SCHEDULED STOP POINTss: B, C
	TARIFF ZONE 3 has SCHEDULED STOP POINTs: Q,  R

From To	Adult Price    
						Zone	1		Zone	2				Zone	3
    Zone	1  		 0.50 EUR		1.00 EUR	 	3.00 EUR		 
    Zone	2	 			-				0.50 EUR		2.00 EUR	
	Zone	3				 -				-					0.75 EUR	
	
 
Point to point  Fare matrix
From To	Adult Price   Child price
    1  1		0.50 EUR		50%
    1  2		1.00 EUR		50%
    1  3		3.00 EUR		50%
    2  2		0.50 EUR		50%
	2  3		2.00 EUR		50%
    3 32		0.75 EUR		50%

==================================
2. DETAILS
 
SCHEDULED STOP POINTs
	    A)   mybus:ssp_001  Alpha 
		B)  mybus:ssp_002   Bravo 
		C)  mybus:ssp_077	 Charley 

		Q)  mybus:ssp_021	 Quebec 
		R)  mybus:ssp_022	 Romeo
 
TARIFF ZONEs
	TARIFF ZONE 1 has SCHEDULED STOP POINT : A
	TARIFF ZONE 2 has SCHEDULED STOP POINTss: B, C
	TARIFF ZONE 3 has SCHEDULED STOP POINTs: Q,  R



TARIFF with FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTS for 
    Access FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTmyfares:Tz2z@access
        DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENTs
	1 1   DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT myfares:Z1+Z1
	1 2   DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT myfares:Z1+Z2
    1 3   DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT myfares:Z1+Z3
    2 2   DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT myfares:Z2+Z2
    2 3   DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT myfares:Z2+Z3
    3 3   DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT myfares:Z3+Z3

    Eligibility  FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:Tz2z@Eligibility
		USER PROFLE - Adults 17 or over 
		USER PROFLE - Child  16 or under  , discounted  

	Conditions of Use ARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:Tz2z@conditions_pf_travel
   		FREQUENCY OF USE   one trip unlimited   myfares:FrequencyOfUse:oneTrip
     		ROUND TRIP OF USE  single
    
FARE PRODUCT:s

	 PREASSIGNED FARE PRODUCT myfares:SingleTrip
		
           With VALIDABLE  ELEMENT  that references

SALES OFFER PACKAGEa   

        SALES OFFER PACKAGE  myfares:SingleTrip-SOP@p-yickey  that references the fare product
 
PRICE GROUP  used to group sets of prices

			USAGE PARAMETER PRICE	myfares:adult    100%
			USAGE PARAMETER PRICE	myfares:adult 	50%

			DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT PRICE myfares:Tz2z@Z1+Z1 : 0.50 EUR
			DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT PRICE myfares:Tz2z@Z1+Z2 : 1.00 EUR
			DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT PRICE myfares:Tz2z@Z1+Z3 : 3.00 EUR
			DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT PRICE myfares:Tz2z@Z2+Z2 : 0.50 EUR
			DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT PRICE myfares:Tz2z@Z2+Z3 : 2.00 EUR
			DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT PRICE myfares:Tz2z@Z3+Z3 : 0.75 EUR


A COMPOSITE FRAME is used to group the component FRAMEs
 
   - It has a VALIDITY CONDITION   and sets the codespaces etc

		A SERVICE  FRAME is used to contain the STOP POINT  elements   LINE, etc
		A FARE  FRAME is used to contain  the FARE  product description   elements 
		A FARE  FRAME is used to contain  the FARE     prices 
		A RESOURCE  FRAME is used to contain  the common code values

-->

<!-- ==== Simple Zone to Zone with peak and Off peak  ratesFare Example ====== 
This example shows the encoding of tariff for a simple bus network witha one to zone stucture  and peak and off peak fares in NeTex XML 
 
It is similar to the simple zonal example except that there are separate 
FARE PRODUCTS for Peak and Off Peak times 

The Prices are held separately in a PRICE GROUP to make it easy to change them 
 
Data is Fictional 

(C) CEN & Crown Copyright 2018, 2019 
Free to use under a Creative Commons license.

v1.1 Add Price refs, revise time_bands corrections

===================================================
 
1. OVERVIEW
============
OPERATOR mybus:Dta  operates  the mybus:DTA NETWORK,  with lines LINE   mybus:Line_24 -  & Line_24_48

		 The first route has just three stops 	 A - B - C 
																		::
	 	The second route 	has stops							B	- Q - R
		
	TARIFF ZONE 1 has SCHEDULED STOP POINT : A
	TARIFF ZONE 2 has SCHEDULED STOP POINTss: B, C , Q 
	TARIFF ZONE 3 has SCHEDULED STOP POINTs: Q, R

Stop Q is in two zones : 2 and 3.


There are separate peak and off peak  prices.
      Peak is Working Weekdays 08:30  to 10:00  am  and 17:00 to 18:30 pm  (holidays excluded)
      Offpeak is other times

There is one  ZoneToZone FARE PRODUCT, covering : 

	Adult Standard Fare
	Child Standard fare
	Adult Peak Fare
	Child Peak fare

Adult prices are
	From To	Adult Price 
						Zone	1		Zone	2				Zone	3
 Zone	1 		 0.50 EUR		1.00 EUR	 	3.00 EUR		 
 Zone	2	 			-				0.50 EUR		2.00 EUR	
	Zone	3				 -				-					0.75 EUR	
	
The prices are thus 
Zone to Zone Fare matrix
				Adult Price 						Child price
From To	OffPeak 		Peak 	
 1 1		0.50 EUR		1.00 EUR		50% 		 
 1 2		1.00 EUR		2.00 EUR		50% 
 1 3		3.00 EUR		4.00 EUR 		50%
 2 2		0.50 EUR		1.00 EUR.		50%
 2 3		2.00 EUR		2.50 EUR.		50%
3 3		0.75 EUR		1.00 EUR.		50%

==================================
2. DETAILS

SCHEDULED STOP POINTs
	    A)   mybus:ssp_001  Alpha 
		B)  mybus:ssp_002   Bravo 
		C)  mybus:ssp_077	 Charley 

		Q)  mybus:ssp_021	 Quebec 
		R)  mybus:ssp_022	 Romeo
 
TARIFF ZONEs
	TARIFF ZONE 1 has SCHEDULED STOP POINT : A
	TARIFF ZONE 2 has SCHEDULED STOP POINTss: B, C
	TARIFF ZONE 3 has SCHEDULED STOP POINTs: Q,  R
 

TARIFF with FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTS for 
   (i)  Access FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTmyfares:Tz2z@access
        DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENTs
	1 1   DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT myfares:Z1+Z1
	1 2   DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT myfares:Z1+Z2
    1 3   DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT myfares:Z1+Z3
    2 2   DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT myfares:Z2+Z2
    2 3   DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT myfares:Z2+Z3
    3 3   DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT myfares:Z3+Z3

   (ii) Eligibility  FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:Tz2z@Eligibility
		USER PROFLE - Adults 17 or over 
		USER PROFLE - Child  16 or under  , discounted  

   (iii) demand type  FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:Tz2z@deman_type
		FARE DEMAND TYPE  - myfares:TF01@demand_types@peak
			FARE DEMAND TYPE  - myfares:TF01@demand_types@opp_peak

	(iv) Conditions of Use ARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:Tz2z@conditions_pf_travel
   		FREQUENCY OF USE   one trip unlimited   myfares:FrequencyOfUse:oneTrip
     		ROUND TRIP OF USE  single
    
FARE PRODUCT:s

	 PREASSIGNED FARE PRODUCT myfares:SingleTrip
		
           With VALIDABLE  ELEMENT  that references the FARE STRUCTUR ELEMENts

SALES OFFER PACKAGEa   

          SALES OFFER PACKAGE  myfares:SingleTrip-SOP@p-ticket  that references the fare product


FARE TABLE  used to group sets of prices 

Two nested FARE TABLES are used to group sets of prices
	OffPeak FARE TABLE myfares:FareTable:offPeak
			USAGE PARAMETER PRICE	myfares:Tz2z@adult 100%
			USAGE PARAMETER PRICE	myfares:Tz2z@adult 	50%

			DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT PRICE myfares:Z1+Z1@offPeak : 0.50 EUR
			DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT PRICE myfares:Z1+Z2@offPeak : 1,00 EUR
			DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT PRICE myfares:Z1+Z3@offPeak : 3.00 EUR
			DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT PRICE myfares:Z2+Z2@offPeak : 0.50 EUR
			DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT PRICE myfares:Z2+Z3@offPeak : 2.00 EUR

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- ==== Simple Unit Distance Fare Example ====== 
This example shows the encoding of a unit distance fare set for a simple bus timetable for a linear route in NeTex XML 
 
Uses a fare based on the number of units between each point. There is a single FARE PRODUCT 

It is based on the same route used in other bus examples e.g. 
		Bus_SimpleTimetable_WithTimings example to see LINKS & PATTERNs
 
It is  extended in other examples with further details
		Bus_SimpleTimetable_PointToPoint_MultipleProducts to see added Fare Products 
		Bus_SimpleTimetable_ZoneToZone_AdultChildProducts to see Zonal Products 
		Bus_SimpleTimetable_ZoneToZone_OffPeakProduct to see added Zonal Products 

Data is Fictional 

(C) CEN & Crown Copyright 2018, 2019 
Free to use under a Creative Commons license.

v1.1 Revised & corrected to use Tariff and simpler ids

===================================================
1. OVERVIEW
============

 Line24 has just four stops   A- (1) - B - (2) - C - (1) - D

Fare Prices are defined in terms of number of units between stops 

Point to point Fare matrix

	AB = gi1 1 unit	 
 BC = gi2 2 unit	 
 CD = gi1 1 unit	 

   A					B 		C 		 D
 D gi1			gi1+g12 	gi1 	 -
 C gi1+g2		gi2 			-
 B gi1	-
 A - 
 
Price Per Unit £1,50

Thus standard fares woudl be calculated as 

   A		B 	C 	 D
 D 1.50	5.50 	1.50 	 -
 C 5.50	3.00 	-
 B 1.50	-
 A - 

==================================
2. DETAILS

There is one Line : LINE 24  for operator mybus@DTA

SCHEDULED STOP POINTs
	 A) mybus:ssp_001 Alpha						 
		B) mybus:ssp_002 Bravo							 
		C) mybus:ssp_077	 Charley
		D) mybus:ssp_078	 Delta 

TARIFF with 

 (a)  are Two GEOGRAPHIC INTERVALs 
	1 Step: GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL: myfares:Unit_Distance@gi_1 
	2 Steps: GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL: myfares:Unit_Distance@gi_2 


(b) FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for 

	 (i) Access FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:Unit_Distance@access

	 (ii) Eligibility FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:Unit_Distance@Eligibility
		USER PROFLE - Adults 17 or over 
		USER PROFLE - Child 16 or under , discounted 

	(iii) Conditions of Travel ARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:Unit_Distance@conditions_of_travel
 		FREQUENCY OF USE one trip unlimited myfares:FrequencyOfUse:oneTrip
  		ROUND TRIP OF USE single
 

 (c) DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENTs

				There are DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENTs for point to point transition, each references a GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL
	AB DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:SSP_001+SSP_002
			GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL: myfares:Unit_Distance@gi_1
 
	BC DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:SSP_002+SSP_077
			GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL: myfares:Unit_Distance@gi_2

 	CD DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:SSP_077+SSP_078 
			GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL: myfares:Unit_Distance@gi_1

FARE PRODUCTs

	 PREASSIGNED FARE PRODUCT myfares:SingleTrip
		
   With VALIDABLE ELEMENT that references the FARE STRUCTUR ELEMENTs

SALES OFFER PACKAGEs 

   SALES OFFER PACKAGE myfares:SingleTrip-SOP@p-ticket that references the FARE PRODUCT
 
PRICE GROUP

 (a)  are Two GEOGRAPHIC INTERVAL PRICEs, 
	1 Step: GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL: myfares:Unit_Distance@gi_1
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVALPRICE: myfares:gip_1 1 Units 1.00 EUR
	2 Steps: GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL: myfares:Unit_Distance@gi_2
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVALPRICE: myfares:gip_2 2 Units  3,0 EUR 

A COMPOSITE FRAME is used to group the component FRAMEs
 
 - It has a VALIDITY CONDITION and sets the codespaces etc

		A SERVICE FRAME is used to contain the STOP POINT elements LINE, etc
		A FARE FRAME is used to contain the FARE product description elements 
		A separate FARE FRAME is used to contain the FARE  prices 
		A RESOURCE FRAME is used to contain the common code values 
-->

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- ==== Simple Unt Zone Fare  Example ====== 
This example shows the encoding of a unit distance tariff or a simple bus timetable for a linear route in NeTex XML  

There is a complex honecomb zone structure with fares based on the number of zones crossed
 

Data is Fictional 

(C) CEN & Crown Copyright 2018, 2019 
Free to use under a Creative Commons license.

v1.1 Revised & corrected to use Tariff and simpler ids

===================================================

1. OVERVIEW
============

   The Fare structure  has a complex zonal matrix with fares based on the number of zones traversed . 
The zones are as follows

	P - - Q
  /  \   /   \  \
 A - B - C - D
  \  /   /	\	/
    X - - - Y 

The TARIFF is defined in terms of   number of units  between  zones 

Zone  to Zone  Fare matrix as number of zones counted 
    
         A		B		C		D	  P	Q		X		Y
	A   1      2      3     4    2		3		2		4
	B   -      1      2     3     2		2		2		3
	C   -      -    	1     2     3		2		2		2
	D   -      -    	 -      1    3	2		4		2
	P   -      -    	 -      -     1	2		3		4
	Q   -      -    	 -      -     -		1		3 		3
	X   -      -    	 -      -     -		-		1 		2
	Y   -      -    	 -      -     -		-		- 		1 

There are separate FARE PRICEs for a one, zone two zone and three zone units, 

==================================
2. DETAILS

There are TARIFF ZONES zones for the NETWORK  mybus:DTA  and OPERATOR  mybus:DTA 

ZONEs
	    A)   mybus:A  Alpha						 
		B)  mybus:B    Bravo							 
		C)  mybus:C  Charley
		D)  mybus:D  Delta
		P)  mybus:D  Papa
		Q)  mybus:D  Quebec
		X)  mybus:X    Xray
		Y)  mybus:Y   Yankee
 

There are DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENTs for   each zone to zone  to point transition,  giving the number of units encountered  e.g.

A  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:A+A 
			GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL: myfares:gi_1zone
				Starts at TARIFF ZONE mybus:A 
				Ends at TARIFF mybus:B"/>
				GeographicalStructureFactor 	 GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL myfares:gi_1zone
	AB  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:A+B"
			GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL: myfares:gi_2zone
				Starts at TARIFF ZONE mybus:A 
				Ends at TARIFF mybus:B"/>
				GeographicalStructureFactor 	 GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL myfares:gi_2zone
	AC  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:A+C"
			GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL: myfares:gi_2zone
				Starts at TARIFF ZONE mybus:A 
				Ends at TARIFF mybus:C"/>
				GeographicalStructureFactor 	 GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL myfares:gi_3zone					 

     ETc Etc   
  

There is a TARIFF   myfares:Stage it has

      (a) GEOGRAPHIC INTERVALS fro 1,2 and 3 stages

	GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVALS are associated with TARIFF ZONES using GEOGRAPHICAL STRUCTURE FACTORs

	GEOGRAPHICAL STRUCTURE FACTOR GeographicalStructureFactor:1zone  :  
			GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVALmyfares:gi_1zone 
			GEOGRAPHICAL I UNIT myfares:1Zone   
	GEOGRAPHICAL STRUCTURE FACTOR GeographicalStructureFactor:2zone  :  
			GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVALmyfares:gi_2zone 
			GEOGRAPHICAL I UNIT myfares:1Zone   
	GEOGRAPHICAL STRUCTURE FACTOR GeographicalStructureFactor:3zone  :  
			GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVALmyfares:gi_3zone 
			GEOGRAPHICAL I UNIT myfares:1Zone   
	GEOGRAPHICAL STRUCTURE FACTOR GeographicalStructureFactor:4zone  :  
			GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL myfares:gi_4zone 
			GEOGRAPHICAL I UNIT myfares:1Zone   


      (b) FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs f 

		  (i) Access FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  GEOGRAPHICLA INTERVALs Unit_Distance@access

		(ii) Eligibility  FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:Unit_Distance@Eligibility
		USER PROFLE - Adults 17 or over 
		USER PROFLE - Child  16 or under  , discounted  

			(iii) Conditions of Travel ARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:Unit_Distance@conditions_of_travel
 		FREQUENCY OF USE one trip unlimited myfares:FrequencyOfUse:oneTrip
  		ROUND TRIP OF USE single

There is a SINGLE FARE PRODUCT  
    It has  a VALIDABLE ELEMENT to make a trip using the specified FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs
  
There are is a PRICE GROUP with three GEOGRAPHIC INTERVAL PRICes S, each with a price
   (i)   GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL  myfares:gi_1zone
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL PRICE : myfares:GeographicalIntervalPrice:gip_1 
				AMOUNT 1.00 
	   GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL PRICE : myfares:GeographicalIntervalPrice:gip_child
				AMOUNT 50%

   (ii) GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL  myfares:gi_2zone
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL PRICE : myfares:GeographicalIntervalPrice:gip_2 
				AMOUNT 1.50 
	GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL PRICE : myfares:GeographicalIntervalPrice:gip_child
				AMOUNT 50%

   (iii) GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL  myfares:gi_3zone
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL PRICE : myfares:GeographicalIntervalPrice:gip_3 
				AMOUNT 3.00 
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL PRICE : myfares:GeographicalIntervalPrice:gip_3_child 
				AMOUNT 50%

   (iv) GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL  myfares:gi_4zone
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL PRICE : myfares:GeographicalIntervalPrice:gip_4 
				AMOUNT 4.00
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL PRICE : myfares:GeographicalIntervalPrice:gip_4_child 
				AMOUNT 50%


A COMPOSITE FRAME is used to group the component FRAMEs 

		A SERVICE  FRAME is used to contain the STOP POINT  elements   LINE, etc
		A FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE product  elements 
		A separate FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE prices
 		A RESOURCE is used to contain the GEOGRAPHICAL UNITs, etc
-->

<!-- ==== SImple Timetable  Example ====== 
This example shows the encoding of a unit distance fare set for a simple bus timetable for a linear route in NeTex XML  
 
Uses a fare based on the number of units between each point. There is a single FARE PRODUCT 

The number of units are indicated by marking teh fare stages along a route using a SERIES CONSTRAINT

This exampel does not describe a fare tbale, just teh underlying paramters used to compute one.

It woudl eb possible to also add


Data is Fictional

Free to use under a Creative Commons license.

v1.1 Revised & corrected to use Tariff and simpler ids

===================================================
1. OVERVIEW
============

   This has just  eight   stops         A - B - C* - D - E - F* - G - H

There are stages at C  and F 

Point to point  Fare matrix

 
Thus standard units  woudl be calculated as 

         A		B   	C  	 D     E    F    G  H
    H  3      3      2      2       2    1    1    - 	  
    G  3      3      2      2       2    1     - 	
    F  2      2      1      1      1     - 	  
    D  2      2      1      1        - 
    C  1      1 		-
    B  1     	-
    A   -    

 
Price for  Units

1 -  £1,50
2 -  £2.50
3.  £  4.00
==================================
2. DETAILS

There is one Line :  LINE 5

SCHEDULED STOP POINTs
	    A)   mybus:ssp_001  Alpha						 
		B)  mybus:ssp_002   Bravo							 
		C)  mybus:ssp_077	 Charley
		D)  mybus:ssp_078	 Delta
		E)  mybus:ssp_101	 Echo
		F)  mybus:ssp_102	 Foxtrot
         g)  mybus:ssp_103	 Golf
         H)  mybus:ssp_103	 Hotel


There is a SERIES CONSTRAINT myfares:Line_5 which markes th fare stages at  stops C and F

THERE IS A TARIFF   myfares:Stage it has
  x

There is a TARIFF   myfares:Stage it has

      (a) GEOGRAPHIC INTERVALS for  1,2 and 3 stages

There are Three GEOGRAPHIC INTERVALS, each with a price
	1 Step: GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL: myfares:Stage@gi_1
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVALPRICE:  myfares:Stage@gi_1   1 Unite  1.00  EUR
	2 Steps: GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL: myfares:Stage@gi_2
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVALPRICE:  myfares:Stage@gip_2   2 Units  3,0 EUR 
	3 Steps: GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL: myfares:Stage@gi_3
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVALPRICE:  myfares:Stage@gip_2   2 Units  4,5 EUR 

      (b) FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs  

		  (i) Access FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  GEOGRAPHICLA INTERVALs Unit_stage@access
				   for SEERIES CONSTRAINT and line 

		(ii) Conditions of Travel ARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:Unit_Distance@conditions_of_travel
 		FREQUENCY OF USE one trip unlimited myfares:FrequencyOfUse:oneTrip
  		ROUND TRIP OF USE single

There is a SINGLE FARE PRODUCT  
    It has  a VALIDABLE ELEMENT to make a trip using the specified FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs
  
There are is a PRICE GROUP with three GEOGRAPHIC INTERVAL PRICes S, each with a price 
	1 Step: 	GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVALPRICE:  myfares:Stage@gi_1   1 Unite  1.00  EUR
	2 Steps: 	GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVALPRICE:  myfares:Stage@gip_2   2 Units  3,0 EUR 
	3 Steps: 	GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVALPRICE:  myfares:Stage@gip_2   2 Units  4,5 EUR 


A COMPOSITE FRAME is used to group the component FRAMEs 

		A SERVICE  FRAME is used to contain the STOP POINT  elements   LINE, etc
		A FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE product  elements 
		A separate FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE prices
 		A RESOURCE is used to contain the GEOGRAPHICAL UNITs, etc
-->

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- ==== Simple Hierarchical Zonal Fare  Example ====== 
This example shows the encoding of a zonal tariff for a simple bus timetable for a linear route in NeTex XML  

There is a complex honecomb zone structure with fares based on the number of zones crossed

 

Data is Fictional 

(C) CEN & Crown Copyright 2018, 2019 
Free to use under a Creative Commons license.

v1.1 Revised & corrected to use Tariff and simpler ids

===================================================

1. OVERVIEW
============

   The Fare structure  has a simple concentric  zonal matrix with fares based Single zone two zone or three zones used . 
The zones are as follows

CCCCCCCCCCCCCCC       
C								C       
C		BBBBBBBB		C       
C		B		 		B		C        
C		B		A		B		C      
C		B		 		B		C       
C		BBBBBBBB		C       
C								C   
CCCCCCCCCCCCCCC     
    
The TARIFF is  defined in terms of   number of units  between  zones 

Zone  to Zone  Fare matrix as number of zones counted 
    
         A		B		C		 
	A   1      2      3     
	B   2      1      2     
	C   3 	 2   	1     
 
There are separate FARE PRICEs for a one, zone two zone and three zone units, and separate FARE PRODUCTs.

==================================
2. DETAILS

There are TARIFF ZONEs for the NETWORK  mybus:DTA

FARE ZONEs
	    A)   mybus:A  Alpha						 
		B)  mybus:B    Bravo							 
		C)  mybus:C  Charley
		 
There are DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENTs for   each zone to zone  to point transition,  e.g.

	AA  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:A+A 
			GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL: myfares:gi_1
				Stars at TARIFF ZONE mybus:A 
				Ends at TARIFF mybus:B"/>
				GeographicalStructureFactor 	 GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL myfares:gi_1
	AB  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:A+B"
			GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL: myfares:gi_2
				Stars at TARIFF ZONE mybus:A 
				Ends at TARIFF mybus:B"/>
				GeographicalStructureFactor 	 GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL myfares:gi_2
	AC  DISTANCE  MATRIX ELEMENT: myfares:A+C"
			GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL: myfares:gi_2
				Stars at TARIFF ZONE mybus:A 
				Ends at TARIFF mybus:C"/>
				GeographicalStructureFactor 	 GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL myfares:gi_3					 

     ETc Etc 
 
There is a TARIFF   myfares:Stage it has

      (a) GEOGRAPHIC INTERVALS fro 1,2 and 3 stages

	Zone use Units are defined and priced  with  GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVALs
   GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL  myfares:gi_2
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL PRICE : myfares:GeographicalIntervalPrice:gip_2 
				AMOUNT 1.50  
    GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL  myfares:gi_3
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL PRICE : myfares:GeographicalIntervalPrice:gip_3 
				AMOUNT 3.00  
   GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL  myfares:gi_4
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL PRICE : myfares:GeographicalIntervalPrice:gip_4 
				AMOUNT 4.00 


      (b) FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs  

		  (i) Access FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  GEOGRAPHICAL   INTERVALs Unit_Zone@access

	 	(ii) Conditions of Travel ARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:Unit_Distance@conditions_of_travel
 		FREQUENCY OF USE one trip unlimited myfares:FrequencyOfUse:oneTrip
  		ROUND TRIP OF USE single

There is a SINGLE FARE PRODUCT  
    It has  a VALIDABLE ELEMENT to make a trip using the specified FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs



There are two SALE OFFER PACKAGES, one for printed ticket , one for a dmobile app, but the prices are the same  
    It has  a VALIDABLE ELEMENT to make a trip using the specified FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs
  
There are is a PRICE GROUP with three GEOGRAPHIC INTERVAL PRICes  , each with a price
 
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL PRICE : myfares:GeographicalIntervalPrice:gip_2 
				AMOUNT 1.50   
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL PRICE : myfares:GeographicalIntervalPrice:gip_3 
				AMOUNT 3.00   
		GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVAL PRICE : myfares:GeographicalIntervalPrice:gip_4 
				AMOUNT 4.00 

A COMPOSITE FRAME is used to group the component FRAMEs 

		A SERVICE  FRAME is used to contain the STOP POINT  elements   LINE, etc
		A FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE product  elements 
		A separate FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE prices
 		A RESOURCE is used to contain the GEOGRAPHICAL UNITs, etc
-->
<PublicationDelivery xmlns="http://www.netex.org.uk/netex" xmlns:siri="http://www.siri.org.uk/siri" xmlns:gml="http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" version="1.0" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.netex.org.uk/netex ../../../xsd/NeTEx_publication.xsd">
	<PublicationTimestamp>2010-12-17T09:30:47.0Z</PublicationTimestamp>
	<ParticipantRef>SYS001</ParticipantRef>
	<!--- ======WHAT WAS REQUESTED ========== -->
	<PublicationRequest version="1.0">
		<RequestTimestamp>2010-12-17T09:30:47.0Z</RequestTimestamp>
		<ParticipantRef>SYS002</ParticipantRef>
		<topics>
			<NetworkFrameTopic>
				<selectionValidityConditions>
					<AvailabilityCondition version="any" id="hde:range">
						<FromDate>2011-01-01T00:00:00Z</FromDate>
					</AvailabilityCondition>
				</selectionValidityConditions>
				<FareFrameRef ref="myfares:any">REQUEST</FareFrameRef>
			</NetworkFrameTopic>
		</topics>
	</PublicationRequest>
	<PublicationRefreshInterval>P1M</PublicationRefreshInterval>
	<Description>Example  of simple point to point fares</Description>
	<!--- =============== RESULTS =========== -->
	<dataObjects>
		<CompositeFrame version="1.0" id="myfares:DTA@Nested_Zone">
			<validityConditions>
				<ValidBetween>
					<FromDate>2011-01-01T00:00:00Z</FromDate>
					<ToDate>2011-07-01T00:00:00Z</ToDate>
				</ValidBetween>
			</validityConditions>
			<!--- ======= CODESPACEs======== -->
			<codespaces>
				<Codespace id="mybus">
					<Xmlns>mybus</Xmlns>
					<XmlnsUrl>http://www.mybuses.eu/stuff</XmlnsUrl>
					<Description>My buses</Description>
				</Codespace>
				<Codespace id="myfares">
					<Xmlns>myfares</Xmlns>
					<XmlnsUrl>http://www.myfares,com/fares</XmlnsUrl>
					<Description>Fare data</Description>
				</Codespace>
			</codespaces>
			<!--- =======FRAME DEFAULTS======== -->
			<FrameDefaults>
				<DefaultCodespaceRef ref="myfares"/>
				<DefaultCurrency>EUR</DefaultCurrency>
			</FrameDefaults>
			<frames>
				<ServiceFrame version="1.0" id="mybus:DTA@Nested_Zone@network">
					<Name>Stops for Fare network </Name>
					<prerequisites>
						<ResourceFrameRef version="1.0" ref="mybus:DTA@Common_Resources"/>
					</prerequisites>
					<Network version="any" id="mybus:DTA">
						<OperatorRef version="any" ref="mybus:DTA"/>
						<tariffZones>
							<TariffZoneRef version="any" ref="mybus:A"/>
							<TariffZoneRef version="any" ref="mybus:B"/>
							<TariffZoneRef version="any" ref="mybus:C"/>
						</tariffZones>
					</Network>
					<!--- =========STOP POINTs============ -->
					<tariffZones>
						<FareZone version="any" id="mybus:A">
							<Name>Alpha </Name>
							<ShortName>A</ShortName>
							<ParentZoneRef version="any" ref="mybus:B"/>
						</FareZone>
						<FareZone version="any" id="mybus:B">
							<Name>Bravo  </Name>
							<ShortName>B</ShortName>
							<ParentZoneRef version="any" ref="mybus:C"/>
							<contains>
								<TariffZoneRef version="any" ref="mybus:A"/>
							</contains>
						</FareZone>
						<FareZone version="any" id="mybus:C">
							<Name>Charley  </Name>
							<ShortName>C</ShortName>
							<contains>
								<TariffZoneRef version="any" ref="mybus:B"/>
							</contains>
						</FareZone>
					</tariffZones>
				</ServiceFrame>
				<!--- =============== FAREs =========== -->
				<FareFrame version="1.0" id="myfares:DTA@Nested_Zone@products">
					<prerequisites>
						<ServiceFrameRef version="1.0" ref="mybus:DTA@Nested_Zone@network"/>
					</prerequisites>
					<!--- ====Fare Structure======= -->
					<geographicalUnits>
						<!--- ====GeographicalU nit======== -->
						<GeographicalUnit version="any" id="myfares:gu">
							<Name>Arbitrary Quantized Unit of Transport Usage - One zone to zone hop</Name>
						</GeographicalUnit>
					</geographicalUnits>
					<tariffs>
						<Tariff version="1.0" id="myfares:Nested_Zone">
							<Name>Zonal fares - Nested zones</Name>
							<OperatorRef version="any" ref="mybus:DTA"/>
							<TypeOfTariffRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:zonal"/>
							<GeographicalUnitRef version="any" ref="myfares:gu"/>
							<!--- ===GEOGRAPHICAL INTERVALs === -->
							<geographicalIntervals>
								<GeographicalInterval version="1.0" id="myfares:gi_1zone">
									<Name>Same zone</Name>
									<NumberOfUnits>1</NumberOfUnits>
									<IntervalType>tariffZone</IntervalType>
									<prices>
										<GeographicalIntervalPriceRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:Nested_Zone@gi_1"/>
									</prices>
								</GeographicalInterval>
								<GeographicalInterval version="1.0" id="myfares:gi_2zone">
									<Name>Two Zones</Name>
									<NumberOfUnits>2</NumberOfUnits>
									<IntervalType>tariffZone</IntervalType>
									<prices>
										<GeographicalIntervalPriceRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:Nested_Zone@gi_2"/>
									</prices>
								</GeographicalInterval>
								<GeographicalInterval version="1.0" id="myfares:gi_3zone">
									<Name>Three Zones</Name>
									<NumberOfUnits>3</NumberOfUnits>
									<IntervalType>tariffZone</IntervalType>
									<prices>
										<GeographicalIntervalPriceRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:Nested_Zone@gi_3"/>
									</prices>
								</GeographicalInterval>
							</geographicalIntervals>
							<!--- ===GEOGRAPHICAL STRUCTURE FACTORS==== -->
							<geographicalStructureFactors>
								<GeographicalStructureFactor version="1.0" id="myfares:1zone">
									<GeographicalIntervalRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:gi_1zone"/>
									<GeographicalUnitRef version="any" ref="myfares:gu"/>
								</GeographicalStructureFactor>
								<GeographicalStructureFactor version="1.0" id="myfares:2zone">
									<GeographicalIntervalRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:gi_2zone"/>
									<GeographicalUnitRef version="any" ref="myfares:gu"/>
								</GeographicalStructureFactor>
								<GeographicalStructureFactor version="1.0" id="myfares:3zone">
									<GeographicalIntervalRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:gi_3zone"/>
									<GeographicalUnitRef version="any" ref="myfares:gu"/>
								</GeographicalStructureFactor>
							</geographicalStructureFactors>
							<fareStructureElements>
								<FareStructureElement version="1.0" id="myfares:Nested_Zone@access">
									<distanceMatrixElements>
										<DistanceMatrixElementRef version="any" ref="myfares:A+A"/>
										<DistanceMatrixElementRef version="any" ref="myfares:A+B"/>
										<DistanceMatrixElementRef version="any" ref="myfares:A+C"/>
										<DistanceMatrixElementRef version="any" ref="myfares:B+B"/>
										<DistanceMatrixElementRef version="any" ref="myfares:B+C"/>
										<DistanceMatrixElementRef version="any" ref="myfares:C+C"/>
									</distanceMatrixElements>
									<GenericParameterAssignment order="1" id="myfares:Nested_Zone@access" version="1.0">
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:can_access"/>
										<ValidityParameterGroupingType>XOR</ValidityParameterGroupingType>
										<validityParameters>
											<NetworkRef version="any" ref="mybus:DTA"/>
										</validityParameters>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
								<FareStructureElement id="myfares:Nested_Zone@conditions_of_travel" version="1.0">
									<Name>eligible user types</Name>
									<GenericParameterAssignment version="1.0" order="1" id="myfares:Nested_Zone@conditions_of_travel">
										<Name>Conditions of travel</Name>
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:condition_of_use"/>
										<LimitationGroupingType>AND</LimitationGroupingType>
										<limitations>
											<RoundTrip version="1.0" id="myfares:Nested_Zone@conditions_of_travel@direction">
												<Name>Single Trip</Name>
												<TripType>single</TripType>
											</RoundTrip>
											<FrequencyOfUse version="1.0" id="myfares:Nested_Zone@conditions_of_travel@frequency">
												<Name>One trip  </Name>
												<FrequencyOfUseType>single</FrequencyOfUseType>
												<MinimalFrequency>1</MinimalFrequency>
												<MaximalFrequency>1</MaximalFrequency>
											</FrequencyOfUse>
											<Interchanging version="1.0" id="myfares:Nested_Zone@conditions_of_travel@interchanging">
												<CanInterchange>true</CanInterchange>
												<CanBreakJourney>false</CanBreakJourney>
											</Interchanging>
											<UsageValidityPeriod version="any" id="myfares:Nested_Zone@conditions_of_travel@until">
												<Name>Valid untile ride complete</Name>
												<UsageEnd>endOfRide</UsageEnd>
											</UsageValidityPeriod>
										</limitations>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
							</fareStructureElements>
							<distanceMatrixElements>

									<Name>Alpha to Alpha</Name>
									<StartTariffZoneRef version="any" ref="mybus:A"/>

									<EndTariffZoneRef version="any" ref="mybus:B"/>

										<GeographicalStructureFactorRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:2zone"/>
									</structureFactors>
								</DistanceMatrixElement>
								<DistanceMatrixElement version="any" id="myfares:A+C">

									<StartTariffZoneRef version="any" ref="mybus:A"/>
									<EndTariffZoneRef version="any" ref="mybus:C"/>
									<structureFactors>
										<GeographicalStructureFactorRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:3zone"/>
									</structureFactors>
								</DistanceMatrixElement>
								<DistanceMatrixElement version="any" id="myfares:B+B">

									<EndTariffZoneRef version="any" ref="mybus:B"/>
									<structureFactors>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- ==== Simple Time Interval Fare   Example ====== 
This example shows the encoding of a time interval  tariff for a simple bus timetable for a zone in NeTex XML  
 
  There   is one  FARE PRODUCT, with differentoptions  for  one hour  , two hour  and all day use

Data is Fictional 

(C) CEN & Crown Copyright 2018, 2019 
Free to use under a Creative Commons license.

v1.1 Revised & corrected to use Tariff and simpler ids

===================================================
 
1. OVERVIEW
============

Fare Prices are defined in terms of   number of   time intervals elapsed

 There are access right sare to use    a single zone  , for one hour , two hours or all day

From 	To			 Price    
    p1	1 unit	1.00 EUR		 
    p2	2 unit	2.50 EUR		 
	p3	3 unit	3.00 EUR		 
	
==================================
2. DETAILS

There is a single  Tariff ZONE 1  for operator mybus:DTA
  
There is a TARIFF   myfares:Time_interval it has

      (a) Three TIME INTERVALS, each with a price
			1 Step: TIME INTERVAL: myfares:ti_1
		TIME INTERVALPRICE:  myfares:tip_1   1H 
			2 Steps: TIME INTERVAL: myfares:ti_2
		TIME INTERVALPRICE:  myfares:tip_2   2H UR
			3 Steps: TIME INTERVAL: myfares:ti_3
		TIME INTERVALPRICE:  myfares:tip_3   8H  


      (b) FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs  

		  (i) Access FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  scope - the TARIFF ZONE  @access

		  (ii) Access FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  TIME   INTERVALs Time_interval@access_when

	 	(iii) Conditions of Travel ARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:Time_interval@conditions_of_travel
 		FREQUENCY OF USE o  unlimited myfares:FrequencyOfUse:oneTrip
  	   INTERCHANGING unlimted

There is a SINGLE FARE PRODUCT   myfares:Period_pass 
    It has  a VALIDABLE ELEMENT to make a trip using the specified FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs

There are two SALE OFFER PACKAGES, one for printed ticket , one for a   mobile app, but the prices are the same  
    It has  a VALIDABLE ELEMENT to make a trip using the specified FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs
  
There are is a PRICE GROUP with three TIME  INTERVAL PRICes  , each with a price
 
			1 Step: TIME INTERVAL: myfares:ti_1   		TIME INTERVALPRICE:  myfares:tip_1   1H 
			2 Steps: TIME INTERVAL: myfares:ti_2   	TIME INTERVALPRICE:  myfares:tip_2   2H UR
			3 Steps: TIME INTERVAL: myfares:ti_3		TIME INTERVALPRICE:  myfares:tip_3   8H  


A COMPOSITE FRAME is used to group the component FRAMEs
 
   - It has a VALIDITY CONDITION  that specifies it is valid from Jan to June

		A SERVICE  FRAME is used to contain the STOP POINT  elements   LINE, etc
		A FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE  product   elements 
		A separate FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE  price   elements 
 		A RESOURCE is used to contain the TIME UNITs, etc
-->
<PublicationDelivery xmlns="http://www.netex.org.uk/netex" xmlns:siri="http://www.siri.org.uk/siri" xmlns:gml="http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" version="1.0" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.netex.org.uk/netex ../../../xsd/NeTEx_publication.xsd">
	<PublicationTimestamp>2010-12-17T09:30:47.0Z</PublicationTimestamp>
	<ParticipantRef>SYS001</ParticipantRef>
	<!--- ======WHAT WAS REQUESTED ========== -->
	<PublicationRequest version="1.0">
		<RequestTimestamp>2010-12-17T09:30:47.0Z</RequestTimestamp>

	<Description>Example  of simple point to point fares</Description>
	<!--- =============== RESULTS =========== -->
	<dataObjects>
		<CompositeFrame version="1.0" id="myfares:DTA@Time_Interval">

			<!--- ======= CODESPACEs======== -->

				</Codespace>
				<Codespace id="myfares">

					<XmlnsUrl>http://www.myfares,com/fares</XmlnsUrl>
