				</Codespace>
			</codespaces>
			<!--- =======FRAME DEFAULTS======== -->
			<FrameDefaults>
				<DefaultCodespaceRef ref="myfares"/>
				<DefaultCurrency>EUR</DefaultCurrency>
			</FrameDefaults>
			<frames>
				<ServiceFrame version="1.0" id="mybus:DTA@Time_Interval@network">
					<Name>Fares  for Winter timetable for Network</Name>
					<prerequisites>
						<ResourceFrameRef version="1.0" ref="mybus:DTA@Common_Resources"/>
					</prerequisites>
					<!--- =========LINEs=========== -->
					<Network version="any" id="mybus:DTA">
						<OperatorRef version="any" ref="mybus:DTA"/>
						<tariffZones>
							<TariffZoneRef version="any" ref="myfares:1"/>
						</tariffZones>
					</Network>
					<tariffZones>
						<!--- ====TARIFF ZONEs ======== -->
						<TariffZone version="any" id="myfares:1">
							<Name>Zone 1</Name>
						</TariffZone>
					</tariffZones>
				</ServiceFrame>
				<!--- =============== FAREs =========== -->
				<FareFrame version="1.0" id="myfares:DTA@Time_Interval@products">
					<prerequisites>
						<ServiceFrameRef version="1.0" ref="mybus:DTA@Time_Interval@network"/>
					</prerequisites>
					<!--- ====Fare Structure======= -->
					<timeUnits>
						<!--- ====TimeU nit======== -->
						<TimeUnit version="1.0" id="myfares:1hour">
							<Name>Time unit of 1 hour</Name>
						</TimeUnit>
					</timeUnits>
					<tariffs>
						<Tariff version="1.0" id="myfares:Time_interval">
							<Name>Zonal Fare</Name>
							<OperatorRef version="any" ref="mybus:DTA"/>
							<TypeOfTariffRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:zonal"/>
							<TimeUnitRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:1hour"/>
							<timeIntervals>
								<TimeInterval version="1.0" id="myfares:1hour">
									<Name>One Hour</Name>
									<Duration>PT1H</Duration>
									<timeStructureFactors>
										<TimeStructureFactor version="1.0" id="myfares:tsf_1h">
											<Name>One hour's  use</Name>
											<Factor>1</Factor>
											<TimeUnitRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:1hour"/>
										</TimeStructureFactor>
									</timeStructureFactors>
								</TimeInterval>
								<TimeInterval version="1.0" id="myfares:2hour">
									<Name>Two Hours</Name>
									<Duration>PT2H</Duration>
									<timeStructureFactors>
										<TimeStructureFactor version="1.0" id="myfares:tsf_2h">
											<Name>Two hour's  use</Name>
											<Factor>2</Factor>
											<TimeUnitRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:1hour"/>
										</TimeStructureFactor>
									</timeStructureFactors>
								</TimeInterval>
								<TimeInterval version="1.0" id="myfares:1day">
									<Name>All Day Use on day of purchase</Name>
									<StartTime>06:00:00</StartTime>
									<EndTime>02:00:00</EndTime>
									<DayOffset>1</DayOffset>
									<timeStructureFactors>
										<TimeStructureFactor version="1.0" id="myfares:tsf_day">
											<Name>All day use on day of purchase</Name>
											<Factor>24</Factor>
											<TimeUnitRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:1hour"/>
										</TimeStructureFactor>
									</timeStructureFactors>
								</TimeInterval>
							</timeIntervals>
							<fareStructureElements>
								<FareStructureElement version="1.0" id="myfares:Time_interval@access">
									<GenericParameterAssignment order="1" id="myfares:Time_interval@access" version="1.0">
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef versionRef="fxc:v1.0" ref="fxc:can_access"/>
										<ValidityParameterGroupingType>XOR</ValidityParameterGroupingType>
										<validityParameters>
											<TariffZoneRef version="any" ref="myfares:1"/>
										</validityParameters>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
								<FareStructureElement version="1.0" id="myfares:Time_interval@access_when">
									<Name>Allowed periods for  use of a  zone</Name>
									<timeStructureFactors>
										<TimeStructureFactorRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:tsf_1h"/>
										<TimeStructureFactorRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:tsf_2h"/>
										<TimeStructureFactorRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:tsf_day"/>
									</timeStructureFactors>
									<GenericParameterAssignment order="1" id="myfares:Time_interval@access_when" version="1.0">
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef versionRef="fxc:v1.0" ref="fxc:can_access_when"/>
										<ValidityParameterGroupingType>XOR</ValidityParameterGroupingType>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
								<FareStructureElement id="myfares:Time_interval@conditions_of_travel" version="1.0">
									<Name>Conditions of travel</Name>
									<GenericParameterAssignment version="1.0" order="1" id="myfares:Time_interval@conditions_of_travel">
										<Name>Conditions of travel</Name>
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef versionRef="fxc:v1.0" ref="fxc:condition_of_use"/>
										<LimitationGroupingType>AND</LimitationGroupingType>
										<limitations>
											<FrequencyOfUse version="1.0" id="myfares:Time_interval@conditions_of_travel@frequency">
												<FrequencyOfUseType>unlimited</FrequencyOfUseType>
											</FrequencyOfUse>
											<Interchanging version="1.0" id="myfares:Time_interval@conditions_of_travel@interchanging">
												<CanInterchange>true</CanInterchange>
												<CanBreakJourney>true</CanBreakJourney>

										</limitations>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
							</fareStructureElements>
							<priceGroups>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- ==== SImple Timetable  Example ====== 
This example shows the encoding of a Zonal fare set for a   bus timetable  in NeTex XML   
 
This example shows the encoding of  separate pricing for  a number of Zone based fares for different periods
  
There are day, weekly and annual fares, and also  special student fares  geared to the student terms

There are both mobile and smartcard   sales packages

There are additional prices fro promo and  funding basis

The prices are presented in a flat form compatible with a legacy export

Data is based on an example 

(C) CEN & Crown Copyright 2018, 2019 
Free to use under a Creative Commons license.

v1.1 Revised & corrected to use Tariff and simpler ids

===================================================

1. OVERVIEW
============

 There  are three  FARE PRODUCTs , 
	
    standard period  pass for 1 day, 1 week 14 week or 1 year 
    day family;  a group ticket
    student:  for acdemic term, 15 week or year   . Only valid in certain areas
 
The student products have a USER PROFILEs
   

There are five  SALES OFFER PACKAGEs - one for every product as a mobile  product.  Adult Monthly and annual passes are also available as travel cards
 
There are different price paarneters for each combination found 
   
 There are some group zones
		 
			day  		week	  4 week    	year    term academic_year  15 week
Midlands  		0.50			0.40				0.40				0.30 

==================================
2. DETAILS

There are a number of TARIFF ZONEs, grouped within two main zones

There are three separate TARIFFs  , one for the standard product, one for the family product and one for teh student product 
     
  I. Standard Tariff   

    There is a  cdla:Time_interval@standard

    (a) TIME INTERVALS Four different  cdla:1day, cdla:1week, cdla:4week, cdla:1year 

      (b) FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs  

		  (i) Access FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  scope - the TARIFF ZONE  @access
				 use of the Network

		  (ii) Access when FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  TIME   INTERVALs standard@access_when
					 Any one of cdla:1day, cdla:1week, cdla:4week, cdla:1year 

		  (iii) Eligibility FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  USER PROFILEs  standard@eligibility
						adult & Child 

	 	(iv) Conditions of Travel ARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT   standard@conditions_of_travel
				FREQUENCY OF USE    unlimited myfares:Frequency 
			   INTERCHANGING unlimted


  II. Family Tariff   

    There is a  cdla:Time_interval@family TARIFF

    (a) TIME INTERVALS    -  only   cdla:1day", 
      (b) FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs  

		  (i) Access FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  scope - the TARIFF ZONE  family@access
				 use of the Network

		  (ii) Access when FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  TIME   INTERVALs family@access_when
				1d ay only

		  (iii) Eligibility FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  USER PROFILEs  family@eligibility
								GROUP TICKET  family

	 	(iv) Conditions of Travel ARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT  family@conditions_of_travel
				FREQUENCY OF USE o  unlimited myfares:Frequency  
			   INTERCHANGING unlimted


  II. Student Tariff   

    There is a  cdla:Time_interval@student TARIFF

    (a) TIME INTERVALS 
				  cdla:1day, cdla:1week, cdla:4week, cdla:1year 
				academic_year;   academic_term@autumn,  academic_term@spring,  academic_term@summer, 
				

    (b) FARE QUALITY FACTORS are used for two different purposes
              (a) different prices for different funding subsidy categories  
				(b) promotional prices  

      (c) FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs  

		  (i) Access FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  scope - the TARIFF ZONEstudent@access
				 limited to specifc zones

		  (ii) Access when FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  TIME   INTERVALs ZONEstudent@access_when
				1Any one of cdla:1day, cdla:1week, cdla:4week, cdla:1year 
					   or academic_term,  academic_year

		  (iii) Eligibility FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  USER PROFILEs  ZONEstudent@eligibility
								USER PROFILE student

	 	(iv) Conditions of Travel ARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT  family@conditions_of_travel
				FREQUENCY OF USE    unlimited myfares:Frequency 
			   INTERCHANGING unlimited

There is a  separate  FARE PRODUCT   for each Tariff myfares:Period_pass 
    Each has  a VALIDABLE ELEMENT to make a trip using the specified FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs


For the Standard product  there are two   SALEs OFFER PACKAGs
    A m-ticket for all TIME INTERVALS
    A smart card for teh monthly and annual IME INTERVALS
 
Tor the family product, there is a SiIngle  SALEs OFFER PACKAGE , mobile for a day ticket 

For the  student product
    There are two SALE OFFER PACKAGES,  ,     There are PURCHASE WINDOW conditions on when the tickets can be bought
		A m-ticket for all TIME INTERVALS
		A smart card for teh monthly and annual TIME INTERVALS
 

	FARE PRICEs  The prices are presented as flat cells in a FARE TABLE - each cell indycates its combination of factors

  There is a USAGE PARAMETER PRICE for exach combination of 
	FARE PRODUCT  + DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT  + 	USER PROFILE  +  USAGE VALIDITY PERIOD

		  for example
		USAGE PARAMETER PRICE 		 cdla:Cannock@adult@day">
									AMOUNT 3.80</Amount>
									USAGE VALIDITY PERIOD: cdla:1day 
									USER PROFILE cdla:adult 
										FARE PRODUCT cdla:zonal 
									 DISTANCE MATRIX ELEMENT  cdla:Cannock 
					 
 
		A COMPOSITE FRAME is used to group the component FRAMEs
   
		A SERVICE  FRAME is used to contain the TARIFF ZONEs
		Three FARE FRAMES ARE used to contain  the FARE    elements  
			 Srandard, family and student
             
		A separate FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE    prices 
 		A RESOURCE is used to contain the TYPE OF CONCESSION, OPERATOR etc 
-->

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- ==== SImple Timetable  Example ====== 
This example shows the encoding of a flat   fare set for w ith a group ticket in NeTex XML  
 
Uses Flat fares   There  are thre  FARE PRODUCT ,: Standard  (one way and return)  and Group Ticket (one way)
 
 
1. OVERVIEW
============
There is  a flat fare to use the network of OPERATOR DTA 

 Fare type									 Single Price    	Return
  Standard fare 							1.00 EUR		 	1.75
   Group Tickeet 10 or more people 75% discount  n/a	
==================================
2. DETAILS

There is one OPERATOR  :  mybus:DTA

There are Three   FARE PRODUCTs

	 Standard: PREASSIGNED FARE PRODUCT myfares:flat_standard_single  
		VALIDITY PARAMETER ASSIGNMENTs
			OPERATOR mybus:DTA
		FARE USAGE PARAMETERs
			FREQUENCY OF USE   one trip  unlimited  myfares:FrequencyOfUse:return 

	 Standard: PREASSIGNED FARE PRODUCT myfares:flat_standard_return
		VALIDITY PARAMETER ASSIGNMENTs
			OPERATOR mybus:DTA
		FARE USAGE PARAMETERs 
			FREQUENCY OF USE   one trip  unlimited  myfares:FrequencyOfUse:return 

	Group PREASSIGNED FARE PRODUCT myfares:flat_group
		VALIDITY PARAMETER ASSIGNMENTs
			OPERATOR mybus:DTA
		FARE USAGE PARAMETERs
			FREQUENCY OF USE   one trip  unlimited  myfares:FrequencyOfUse:return 
			GROUP TICKET - 10 or more  myfares:GroupTicketRef:group
 
	Prices 
		FARE PRODUCT PRICE : myfares:standard   1.00 EUR
		FARE PRODUCT PRICE : myfares:return  1.75 EUR
								 
		USAGE PARAMETER   PRICE :myfares:group"> 75%
									 

A COMPOSITE FRAME is used to group the component FRAMEs
 
   - It has a VALIDITY CONDITION  that specifies it is valid from Jan to June

		A SERVICE  FRAME is used to contain the STOP POINT  elements   LINE, etc
		A FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE    elements 
 		A RESOURCE is used to contain the OPERATORs, etc
-->
<PublicationDelivery xmlns="http://www.netex.org.uk/netex" xmlns:siri="http://www.siri.org.uk/siri" xmlns:gml="http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" version="1.0" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.netex.org.uk/netex ../../../xsd/NeTEx_publication.xsd">
	<PublicationTimestamp>2010-12-17T09:30:47.0Z</PublicationTimestamp>
	<ParticipantRef>SYS001</ParticipantRef>
	<!--- ======WHAT WAS REQUESTED ========== -->
	<PublicationRequest version="1.0">
		<RequestTimestamp>2010-12-17T09:30:47.0Z</RequestTimestamp>
		<ParticipantRef>SYS002</ParticipantRef>
		<topics>
			<NetworkFrameTopic>
				<selectionValidityConditions>
					<AvailabilityCondition version="any" id="mybus:range">

			</NetworkFrameTopic>

	<Description>Example  of simple point to point fares</Description>
	<!--- =============== RESULTS =========== -->
	<dataObjects>
		<CompositeFrame version="1" id="myfares:DTA@Flat">
			<validityConditions>
				<ValidBetween>
					<FromDate>2011-01-01T00:00:00Z</FromDate>

			</validityConditions>
			<!--- ======= CODESPACEs======== -->
			<codespaces>
				<Codespace id="mybus">
					<Xmlns>mybus</Xmlns>

				<Codespace id="myfares">

			</codespaces>

										<ValidityParameterGroupingType>XOR</ValidityParameterGroupingType>

										</validityParameters>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
								<FareStructureElement version="1.0" id="myfares:Flat@eligibility">
									<Name>Eligible user types</Name>
									<GenericParameterAssignment order="1" id="myfares:Flat@eligibility" version="1.0">
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:eligible"/>
										<LimitationGroupingType>XOR</LimitationGroupingType>
										<limitations>
											<!--- ===ELIGIBILITY USAGE PARAMETERS ========= -->

												<MaximumAge>16</MaximumAge>

											</GroupTicket>
										</limitations>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
								<FareStructureElement id="myfares:Flat@conditions_of_travel@single" version="1.0">
									<Name>Conditions of travel</Name>
									<GenericParameterAssignment version="1.0" order="1" id="myfares:Flat@conditions_of_travel@single">
										<Name>Conditions of travel</Name>
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:condition_of_use"/>
										<LimitationGroupingType>AND</LimitationGroupingType>
										<limitations>

												<Name>Single</Name>
												<TripType>single</TripType>
											</RoundTrip>
											<FrequencyOfUse version="1.0" id="myfares:Flat@conditions_of_travel@single@frequency">
												<FrequencyOfUseType>single</FrequencyOfUseType>
												<MaximalFrequency>1</MaximalFrequency>
											</FrequencyOfUse>
											<Interchanging version="1.0" id="myfares:Flat@conditions_of_travel@single@interchanging">
												<CanInterchange>true</CanInterchange>
												<FromMode>metro</FromMode>
												<ToMode>metro</ToMode>
												<CanBreakJourney>false</CanBreakJourney>
											</Interchanging>
										</limitations>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
								<FareStructureElement id="myfares:Flat@conditions_of_travel@outbound" version="1.0">
									<Name>Conditions of travel</Name>
									<GenericParameterAssignment version="1.0" order="1" id="myfares:Flat@conditions_of_travel@outbound">
										<Name>Conditions of travel</Name>
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:condition_of_use"/>
										<LimitationGroupingType>AND</LimitationGroupingType>
										<limitations>

												<FrequencyOfUseType>single</FrequencyOfUseType>
												<MaximalFrequency>1</MaximalFrequency>
											</FrequencyOfUse>
											<Interchanging version="1.0" id="myfares:Flat@conditions_of_travel@outbound@interchanging">
												<CanInterchange>true</CanInterchange>
												<CanBreakJourney>false</CanBreakJourney>
											</Interchanging>
										</limitations>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
								<FareStructureElement id="myfares:Flat@conditions_of_travel@inbound" version="1.0">

										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:condition_of_use"/>
										<LimitationGroupingType>AND</LimitationGroupingType>
										<limitations>

												<CanBreakJourney>false</CanBreakJourney>
											</Interchanging>
										</limitations>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- ==== Simple Railcard tarriff  Example ====== 
This example shows the encoding of a rail card with  discount rights  on purchase  of rail tickets in NeTex XML  
 
 There  are three types of rail card  , standard, senior and student  
 These  allow a discount on ticket  purchases
 
Fictional data

(C) CEN & Crown Copyright 2018, 2019 
Free to use under a Creative Commons license.

v1.1 Revised & corrected to use Tariff and simpler ids

===================================================
  
1. OVERVIEW
============
 
	Standard Rail card  has 5% discount  (Same dsicount  for adults and childrn) Available for 1 or 2 years
	Student  card has 20% discount   Available for 1  year only
	Senior  card has 20% discount    Available for 1 or 2 years
 
==================================
2. DETAILS

There is one Operator  :  DTA
 
There is one  FARE PRODUCT 

	 SALES DISCOUNT RIGHT  myfares:railcard@standard  
		VALIDITY PARAMETER ASSIGNMENTs
			OPERATOR mytoc:DTA
		FARE USAGE PARAMETERs 
			USER PROFILE - 1 myfares:standard

There are multiple SALES OFFF PACKAGES, one for each type of Railcard

	Student PREASSIGNED FARE PRODUCT myfares:railcard@student
		VALIDITY PARAMETER ASSIGNMENTs
			OPERATOR mytoc:DTA
		FARE USAGE PARAMETERs 
			USER PROFILE -   myfares:student
 
	PRices 
		FARE PRODUCT   PRICE :myfares:railcard@standard   5%
								 
		FARE PRODUCT   PRICE :myfares:railcard@student  > 10%
									 

A COMPOSITE FRAME is used to student the component FRAMEs
 
		A FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE    elements 
 		A RESOURCE is used to contain the TIME UNITs, etc

There is a TARIFF   myfares:Railcard_discount it has

      (a) Two TIME INTERVALS, each with a price  myfares:1year
			1 Step: TIME INTERVAL: myfares:1year 
			2 Steps: TIME INTERVAL: myfares:2year 

      (b) FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs  

		  (i) Access FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  scope - the    @access
				The operator and mode for whom products are availkable

		  (ii) Accesswehn FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  TIME   INTERVALs Time_interval@access_when
				 The Time Intervals

		  (iii) Eligibility FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs for  TIME   INTERVALs Time_interval@eligible
				 USER PROIFLEs for adult, child, student Senior

	 	(iiv) Conditions of Travel ARE STRUCTURE ELEMENT myfares:Time_interval@conditions_of_sale
 		 

There is a SINGLE FARE PRODUCT   myfares:Railcard 
    It has  a VALIDABLE ELEMENT to make a trip using the specified FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs

There are multiple SALES OFFET PACKAGES, one for each type of Railcard
		standard: myfares:Railcard-SOP@standard 
	    student:  myfares:Railcard-SOP@student  -  restricted to USER PROFILE student & TIEME INTERVAL 1 year
       senior:   myfares:Railcard-SOP@senior  - restricted to USER PROFILE senior  

There is a GROUP SALES OFFER PACKAGES, that specifies common properties
    Each has  a SALES OFFER PACKAGE  ELEMENT to make a trip using the specified FARE STRUCTURE ELEMENTs
  
There are is a PRICE GROUP with four  USAGE PARAMETER PRICes  , each with a  discounting price
 
			1  USER PROFILE: myfares:adult  		USAGE PARAMETER PRICE:  myfares:With_Railcard@adult 
			2  USER PROFILE: myfares:child  		USAGE PARAMETER PRICE:  myfares:With_Railcard@child
			3  USER PROFILE: myfares:student  		USAGE PARAMETER PRICE:  myfares:With_Railcard@student
			4  USER PROFILE: myfares:senior  		USAGE PARAMETER PRICE:  myfares:With_Railcard@senior


There are is a FARE TABLE with the prices for purchasing a   RAILCARD for various periods
 
It contains three nested tables one for each SALES OFFER PACKAGE 
 
        FARE TABLE for  Myfares:Railcard-SOP@standard 
			1  TIME INTERVAL: myfares:1year   		TIME INTERVALPRICE:  Myfares:Railcard-SOP@standard@1year
			2  TIME INTERVAL: myfares:2year   	TIME INTERVALPRICE:  mMyfares:Railcard-SOP@standard@2year
        FARE TABLE for  Myfares:Railcard-SOP@student 
			1  TIME INTERVAL: myfares:1year   		TIME INTERVALPRICE:  Myfares:Railcard-SOP@student@1year 
        FARE TABLE for  Myfares:Railcard-SOP@senior 
			1  TIME INTERVAL: myfares:1year   		TIME INTERVALPRICE:  Myfares:Railcard-SOP@senior@1year
			2  TIME INTERVAL: myfares:2year   	TIME INTERVALPRICE:  mMyfares:Railcard-SOP@senior@2year

A COMPOSITE FRAME is used to group the component FRAMEs
 
   - It has a VALIDITY CONDITION  that specifies it is valid from Jan to June
		 
		A FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE  product   elements 
		A separate FARE FRAME is used to contain  the FARE  price   elements 
 		A RESOURCE is used to contain the OPERATOR, etc
-->
<PublicationDelivery xmlns="http://www.netex.org.uk/netex" xmlns:siri="http://www.siri.org.uk/siri" xmlns:gml="http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" version="1.0" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.netex.org.uk/netex ../../../xsd/NeTEx_publication.xsd">
	<PublicationTimestamp>2010-12-17T09:30:47.0Z</PublicationTimestamp>
	<ParticipantRef>SYS001</ParticipantRef>

	<PublicationRequest version="1.0">
		<RequestTimestamp>2010-12-17T09:30:47.0Z</RequestTimestamp>
		<ParticipantRef>SYS002</ParticipantRef>
		<topics>
			<NetworkFrameTopic>
				<selectionValidityConditions>
					<AvailabilityCondition version="any" id="mytoc:range">
						<FromDate>2011-01-01T00:00:00Z</FromDate>
					</AvailabilityCondition>
				</selectionValidityConditions>
				<FareFrameRef ref="myfares:any">REQUEST</FareFrameRef>
			</NetworkFrameTopic>
		</topics>
	</PublicationRequest>
	<PublicationRefreshInterval>P1M</PublicationRefreshInterval>
	<Description>Example  of simple point to point fares</Description>
	<!--- =============== RESULTS =========== -->
	<dataObjects>
		<CompositeFrame version="1" id="myfares:DTA@RailCards">
			<validityConditions>
				<ValidBetween>
					<FromDate>2011-01-01T00:00:00Z</FromDate>
					<ToDate>2011-07-01T00:00:00Z</ToDate>
				</ValidBetween>
			</validityConditions>
			<!--- ======= CODESPACEs======== -->
			<codespaces>
				<Codespace id="mytoc">
					<Xmlns>mytoc</Xmlns>
					<XmlnsUrl>http://www.mytoc.eu/network</XmlnsUrl>
					<Description>My train operator</Description>
				</Codespace>
				<Codespace id="myfares">
					<Xmlns>myfares</Xmlns>
					<XmlnsUrl>http://www.mytoc.eu/fares</XmlnsUrl>
					<Description>Fare  data</Description>
				</Codespace>
			</codespaces>
			<FrameDefaults>
				<DefaultCurrency>EUR</DefaultCurrency>
			</FrameDefaults>
			<frames>
				<!--- =============== FAREs =========== -->
				<FareFrame version="1.0" id="myfares:DTA@RailCards@products">
					<prerequisites>
						<ResourceFrameRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:DTA@Common_Resources"/>
					</prerequisites>
					<!--- ====Fare Structure======= -->
					<tariffs>
						<Tariff version="1.0" id="myfares:Railcard_discount">
							<Name>Railcard Discount  tariff</Name>
							<OperatorRef version="any" ref="mytoc:DTA"/>
							<TypeOfTariffRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:zonal"/>
							<timeIntervals>
								<TimeInterval version="1.0" id="myfares:Railcard_discount@1year">
									<Name>One Year</Name>
									<Duration>P1Y</Duration>
								</TimeInterval>
								<TimeInterval version="1.0" id="myfares:Railcard_discount@2year">
									<Name>Two Years</Name>
									<Duration>P2Y</Duration>
								</TimeInterval>
								<!--  installments -->
								<TimeInterval version="1.0" id="myfares:payment_installment@3month">
									<Duration>P3M</Duration>
								</TimeInterval>
								<TimeInterval version="1.0" id="myfares:payment_installment@6month">
									<Duration>P6M</Duration>
								</TimeInterval>
								<TimeInterval version="1.0" id="myfares:payment_installment@1year">
									<Name>One Year</Name>
									<Duration>P1Y</Duration>
								</TimeInterval>
							</timeIntervals>
							<fareStructureElements>
								<FareStructureElement version="1.0" id="myfares:Railcard_discount@access">
									<GenericParameterAssignment order="1" id="myfares:Flat@access" version="1.0">
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:can_access"/>
										<ValidityParameterGroupingType>XOR</ValidityParameterGroupingType>
										<validityParameters>
											<VehicleModes>rail</VehicleModes>
											<OperatorRef version="any" ref="mytoc:DTA"/>
										</validityParameters>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
								<FareStructureElement version="1.0" id="myfares:Railcard_discount@access_when">
									<Name>Allowed periods for  use of a  Railcard</Name>
									<timeIntervals>
										<TimeIntervalRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:Railcard_discount@1year"/>
										<TimeIntervalRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:Railcard_discount@2year"/>
									</timeIntervals>
									<GenericParameterAssignment order="1" id="myfares:Time_interval@access_when" version="1.0">
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef versionRef="fxc:v1.0" ref="fxc:can_access_when"/>
										<LimitationGroupingType>AND</LimitationGroupingType>
										<limitations>
											<UsageValidityPeriod version="1.0" id="myfares:Time_interval@access_whes">
												<ValidityPeriodType>seasonTicket</ValidityPeriodType>
												<UsageTrigger>specifiedStartDate</UsageTrigger>
												<UsageStartConstraintType>variable</UsageStartConstraintType>
												<startOnlyOn>
													<DayType id="myfares:Time_interval@access_when" version="1.0">
														<properties>
															<PropertyOfDay>
																<DayOfMonth>---01</DayOfMonth>
															</PropertyOfDay>
														</properties>
													</DayType>
												</startOnlyOn>
											</UsageValidityPeriod>
										</limitations>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
								<FareStructureElement version="1.0" id="myfares:Railcard_discount@can_purchase">
									<Name>Allowed periods for payment installationsd</Name>
									<timeIntervals>
										<TimeIntervalRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:payment_installment@3month"/>
										<TimeIntervalRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:payment_installment@6month"/>
										<TimeIntervalRef version="1.0" ref="myfares:payment_installment@1year"/>
									</timeIntervals>
									<GenericParameterAssignment order="1" id="myfares:Time_interval@can_purchase" version="1.0">
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef versionRef="fxc:v1.0" ref="fxc:can_purchase"/>
										<ValidityParameterGroupingType>XOR</ValidityParameterGroupingType>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
								<FareStructureElement version="1.0" id="myfares:Railcard_discount@eligibility">
									<Name>Eligible user types</Name>
									<GenericParameterAssignment order="1" id="myfares:Flat@eligibility" version="1.0">
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:eligible"/>
										<LimitationGroupingType>XOR</LimitationGroupingType>
										<limitations>
											<UserProfile version="any" id="myfares:adult">
												<Name>Normal</Name>
												<TypeOfConcessionRef version="any" ref="myfares:standard"/>
											</UserProfile>
											<UserProfile version="any" id="myfares:child">
												<Name>Child</Name>
												<TypeOfConcessionRef version="any" ref="myfares:concession"/>

											</UserProfile>
											<UserProfile version="any" id="myfares:student">
												<Name>Student</Name>
												<TypeOfConcessionRef version="any" ref="myfares:concession"/>
												<ProofRequired>membershipCard</ProofRequired>
											</UserProfile>
											<UserProfile version="any" id="myfares:senior">
												<Name>Senior</Name>
												<TypeOfConcessionRef version="any" ref="myfares:concession"/>
												<MinimumAge>60</MinimumAge>
												<ProofRequired>drivingLicence passport</ProofRequired>
											</UserProfile>
										</limitations>
									</GenericParameterAssignment>
								</FareStructureElement>
								<FareStructureElement id="myfares:Railcard_discount@conditions_of_sale" version="1.0">
									<Name>Conditions of use</Name>
									<GenericParameterAssignment version="1.0" order="1" id="myfares:Railcard_discount@conditions_of_sale">
										<TypeOfAccessRightAssignmentRef version="ntx:v1.0" ref="ntx:condition_of_sale"/>

							<!-- === PRICES ==== -->
